jobs.excerpt: Description• Implement Temporal workflow activities in Go: HSS adapter, PCRF adapter, Inventory update.
jobs.description:
Description

  • Implement Temporal workflow activities in Go: HSS adapter, PCRF adapter, Inventory update.
  • Build and validate unit tests for all workflow activities from day one.
  • Build the Inventory Management Database: tables, indexes, partitioning for 30M records.
  • Build bulk import tooling: CSV → ICCID/IMSI/MSISDN range ingestion from vendor.
  • Implement REST API endpoints for Inventory DB (allocate, reserve, release, query SIM records).
  • Write integration tests: workflow → mock NE → database assertions.
  • Support Sr. Developer on all workflow development tasks — pair programming expected.
  • End-to-end test suite: full provisioning flow from SIM activation to order closed.
  • Load and stress testing: simulate peak TPS provisioning against all systems.
  • Test automation: CI pipeline integration for all workflow and API tests.
  • HSS sync integration: IMSI allocation state reflected in HSS (mock → real NE).
  • MNP (number portability) hooks in Inventory DB.
  • UAT support: reproduce bugs, write regression tests, validate fixes.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 2–4 years backend software development in production environments.
  • Go or Java — primary development language for this role is Go.
  • Java accepted if strong fundamentals and willing to work in Go (we will support the transition).
  • REST API development — building APIs consumed by other services and tested by automated suites.
  • PostgreSQL — table design, indexes, writing queries, understanding query plans .
  • Unit and integration testing — writing tests is a first-class responsibility, not an afterthought.
  • Git — branching, pull requests, code review participation.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures using RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Redis Pub/Sub.
  • Basic Kubernetes knowledge — understanding how your workloads are deployed.
  • Ability to work under technical direction of a senior lead and execute quickly.
  • Fluent English.

Strong Advantage

  • * Any workflow engine experience: Temporal, Camunda, Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions.
  • * Telecom or BSS/OSS background — understanding of SIM lifecycle, provisioning, activation.
  • * Test framework experience: Go testing, Testify, mock frameworks.
  • * Load testing tools: k6, Locust, JMeter — running and interpreting results.
  • * Docker — building and running containerised services.
  • * Experience with event-sourced or append-only database patterns.

Nice to Have

  • Temporal.io SDK experience — even personal/side project counts.
  • Python — useful for scripting, test tooling, data processing.
  • Prometheus — understanding how to instrument code with metrics.
  • Telecom protocol familiarity: Diameter, SS7, SMPP.

About Webbing

Founded in early 2010, Webbing is a global data MVNO that delivers enterprise grade, global connectivity and IoT services across more than 200 countries and 600+ mobile carriers' networks. Webbing's secured network delivers network protection and web content intelligence.

Enterprise customers can manage, monitor, and optimize data usage in real-time with Webbing's powerful software platform. Gain visibility by application type and have the power to white list applications and limit non-business applications with the click of a button, saving money and improving compliance.

What we offer

  • Fully remote
  • An exciting and challenging greenfield platform with great skill and knowledge development opportunities.
  • The opportunity to join a team of highly professional specialists in an international environment.
  • The opportunity for professional development within a reputable international innovative and growing company.

Overview/About Lumanity

Lumanity is dedicated to improving patient health by accelerating and optimizing access to medical advances. We partner with life sciences companies around the world to generate evidence to demonstrate the value of their product, translate the science and data into compelling product narratives, and enable commercial decisions that position these products for success in the market. We do this through strategic and complimentary areas of focus: Asset Optimization and Commercialization, Value Access and Outcomes, Medical Strategy and Communications, and Real-World Evidence.

Responsibilities / Position overview

The Systems Specialist serves as the primary point of contact for day-to-day system administration across assigned accounts, playing a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of project data. This role sits at the intersection of project delivery, finance operations, and systems management, acting as a key connector between internal teams to keep projects on track and financial data aligned.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated primary point of contact for day-to-day Kantata system administration on assigned accounts, ensuring the integrity of all assigned project-related data.
  • Maintain a working understanding of NetSuite as it relates to Kantata functionality.
  • Liaise with Client Project Leads to maintain accurate, up-to-date project information, including aligning project values based on client scope of work or change orders, invoicing cadence, addition of people resources, etc.
  • Liaise with Finance Operations for Sales Order set-up and changes, as appropriate.
  • Attend internal team status meetings and update systems accordingly based on discussions.
  • Inform the Client Project Lead when billing volume risks potential overage on a deliverable/task.
  • Review out-of-pocket costs included each month on completed Client invoices and update system to ensure those costs are marked as completed.
  • Monitor Kantata for potential client overservice situations;communicate relevant tasks and details to the Client Project Lead in a timely manner for further action planning.
  • Schedule and attend monthly EAC meetings; ensure details discussed are reflected in Kantata in alignment with soft and hard close deadlines and related activities.
  • Capture and action month-end changes required across assigned projects.
  • Support business planning preparation by helping to compile required information in the agreed format.
  • Upon confirmation from the Client Project Lead that the project is “Complete,” verify that all tasks, billing milestones, and pass-through cost line items are appropriately marked “Complete,” mark the entire project “Complete” and liaise with Financial Operations to conduct a post-completion audit and execute the archiving process.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2 years in project administration or coordination; business or financial operational support; ERP/PSA system administration (experience with Kantata or similar system(s), such as FinancialForce, Workday PSA, etc)
  • Preferred experience:
    • Hands-on experience with managing project budgets, hours, and expenses, as well as coordinating among multiple stakeholders
    • Implementing best practices for data accuracy and reporting
    • Med Comm industry experience
  • Financial acumen
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to multi-task and collaborate with internal teams
  • Strong oral and written communication skills

Benefits

We offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that focuses on what matters to you – health and well-being, personal finances, professional development, and a healthy work/life balance:

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Help Universities Discover Human Potential.  Become a Trusted Partner.
jobs.description:
Help Universities Discover Human Potential. Become a Trusted Partner.

The best customer relationships begin with trust: understanding what a partner is trying to achieve, helping them work through difficult challenges, and showing up with insights when it matters.

At Acuity Insights, those conversations happen in a uniquely meaningful context. We partner with higher education institutions making some of the most important decisions they’ll make: who gets the opportunity to enter a profession, how potential is understood beyond grades alone, and how learners are supported throughout their journey.

As our next Customer Success Manager, you’ll build trusted partnerships with admissions leaders, educators, and program teams, helping them realize the full value of our products while uncovering new opportunities to deepen those relationships over time.

This is a Customer Success role where helping customers realize long-term value naturally leads to renewals, growth, and lasting partnerships. The difference is how you get there. Our strongest partnerships grow because customers trust our guidance, see meaningful outcomes, and choose to deepen their relationship with us over time.

If you enjoy turning thoughtful conversations into trusted partnerships and meaningful growth, you’ll find work here that reaches far beyond the account itself.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Canada.

Before you apply: Thoughtful use of AI is encouraged. If you use it to support your application, please make sure it helps communicate your experience clearly and accurately. The strongest applications are authentic, original, and unmistakably yours.

The Work You’ll Do

In your first few weeks, you’ll immerse yourself in our customers’ world. You’ll learn how admissions and learner development work across higher education, get to know the institutions in your portfolio, and build a deep understanding of the challenges they’re trying to solve.

You’ll gradually take ownership of your portfolio, giving you the opportunity to understand each institution, build meaningful relationships, and grow your confidence before independently managing your full portfolio. You’ll have the autonomy to own your customer relationships while knowing you’ll always have experienced teammates to collaborate with as you begin leading customer conversations, supporting renewals, and identifying opportunities to create value for the institutions you support.

You’ll support a diverse portfolio of higher education institutions across North America, building long-term relationships with admissions leaders, educators, and program teams. While much of your work happens remotely, you’ll also have opportunities to meet customers in person through campus visits, conferences, and industry events because some of the strongest partnerships are built face to face. Your workday will naturally align with the time zones of the customers you support.

As your confidence grows, you’ll become a strategic partner to your customers. You’ll lead renewal conversations, identify opportunities for growth, and help institutions navigate new challenges as their needs evolve. You’ll connect customer needs with the broader capabilities of Acuity, helping institutions get more value from the solutions they use today while identifying opportunities where we can support them in new ways.

You’ll also join us at an exciting point in the evolution of Customer Success at Acuity. We’re intentionally building a more strategic, and customer-centered approach to partnering with our institutions. You’ll help shape that evolution by working closely with Sales, Product, and cross-functional teams to strengthen the customer experience and contribute to the next chapter of Customer Success.

What You’ll Help Make Possible

The relationships you build will have an impact far beyond your own portfolio. You’ll help higher education institutions get more value from their partnership with Acuity while contributing directly to our growth and the continued evolution of Customer Success.

Build partnerships customers want to grow.
Develop trusted, long-term relationships that help institutions achieve meaningful outcomes and choose to continue growing with Acuity year after year.

Help customers solve bigger challenges.
Understand where your customers are headed and connect them with the products, insights, and support that help them achieve their goals. Growth follows because you’re creating genuine value, not pursuing opportunities for their own sake.

Bring the voice of the customer into Acuity.
Share customer insights across Product, Sales, Marketing, and other teams, helping shape better products, stronger customer experiences, and smarter business decisions.

Help define the next chapter of Customer Success.
As Customer Success continues to evolve at Acuity, you’ll contribute ideas, refine playbooks, and help shape a more strategic, commercially accountable, and customer-centered function.

The impact of your work will be visible in stronger customer relationships, healthier renewals, meaningful commercial growth, and institutions that continue choosing Acuity as a trusted partner. More importantly, every partnership you strengthen helps educators make better decisions about people and gives more learners the opportunity to be seen for their full potential.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn’t about quick wins. It’s about earning trust, creating momentum, and delivering meaningful outcomes for both your customers and the business.

In your first three months, you’ll have built a strong understanding of your customers, their goals, and the challenges they’re working to solve. You’ll be confidently managing your initial portfolio with support from your team, establishing a healthy renewal rhythm, and beginning to identify opportunities to deepen customer partnerships over time.

By the end of your first year, you’ll be a trusted advisor to your customers, confidently leading renewals, navigating complex conversations, and contributing directly to retention and revenue growth. You’ll have helped customers adopt new capabilities where they create meaningful value, strengthening both their success and Acuity’s.

Throughout the year, you’ll build strong habits around customer health, proactive communication, and thoughtful account planning. Your customers will know they can count on you, your teammates will value your perspective, and your insights will help shape decisions across Customer Success, Product, Sales, and beyond.

As Customer Success continues to evolve, you’ll contribute ideas, refine playbooks, and help shape how we continue raising the bar. You’ll be part of a team that’s building a more strategic, commercially accountable, and customer-centered approach to partnering with our customers.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll report to the leader of our Assessments Customer Success function, joining a team that’s intentionally evolving how we partner with customers.

Customer Success is deeply collaborative at Acuity. You’ll work closely with colleagues across the business to create a seamless experience for our customers and help shape how we grow.

Sales, to ensure smooth handoffs, align on growth opportunities, and create a consistent customer journey.

Product, to bring customer insights into roadmap conversations and help shape the future of our products.

Marketing, to share customer stories, identify emerging needs, and strengthen how we communicate the value of our solutions.

Support Operations, to remove friction quickly, coordinate through critical customer moments, and ensure institutions have confidence in every interaction with Acuity.

The best ideas rarely come from one team alone. Some of your biggest contributions will come from connecting people, bringing the voice of the customer into the business, and helping teams make better decisions because of those insights.

How You’ll Succeed Here

There’s no single profile for success in this role. But the people who thrive here tend to share a few things in common. They’re curious, thoughtful, strategically minded, and genuinely invested in helping their customers succeed.

You stay curious.
You want to understand the problems your customers are trying to solve, not just the products they use. You ask thoughtful questions, connect information from different sources, and uncover opportunities others might miss.

You build expertise.
You enjoy learning. Whether it’s our products, admissions processes, or the higher education landscape, you know that the best customer conversations are grounded in deep understanding, not surface-level knowledge.

You take ownership.
You see your portfolio as something you own, not something you manage. When something is unclear or still evolving, you move work forward, follow through, and stay engaged until there’s a clear outcome.

You communicate with clarity and confidence.
You’re thoughtful, direct, and comfortable having difficult conversations when they’re needed. You create clarity, build trust, and help people move forward together.

You thrive in change.
You’re energized by growth and comfortable working in an environment that’s continually evolving. You adapt quickly, stay resilient when priorities shift, and use new tools, including AI, thoughtfully to work more effectively and better support your customers.

You balance customer success with commercial thinking.
You understand that lasting customer relationships and strong business outcomes go hand in hand. You’re comfortable leading renewals, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping customers invest where they’ll see genuine value.

Experience That Will Help You Hit the Ground Running

There’s no single path into this role, and we don’t believe great Customer Success talent is measured by years of experience alone. What matters most is that you’ve had the opportunity to build customer relationships, take ownership of outcomes, and grow from those experiences.

You’ll likely bring experience in:

  • Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or another customer-facing role where you’ve owned customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts.
  • Guiding customers through implementation, adoption, and renewals while balancing customer value with business outcomes.
  • Building relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigating challenging conversations, and earning trust over time.
  • Using CRM and Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce, ChurnZero, or similar tools.
  • Working independently in a remote environment with a high degree of ownership, sound judgment, and initiative.
  • Supporting customers across North American time zones.

If you’re earlier in your Customer Success career but have demonstrated exceptional curiosity, ownership, and a track record of building trusted customer relationships, we’d still love to hear from you.

How We Support You

  • Transparent compensation. A salary between $85,000 - $110,000 CAD, aligned to role scope, experience, and internal equity.
  • Learning that grows with you. A $3,000 annual learning budget to invest in your development, whether that’s deepening technical skills, building confidence, or exploring new areas of interest.
  • Shared success. Access to employee stock options, so you share in the value you help create.
  • Remote-first work. Fully remote within Canada, with up to six weeks per year to work internationally.
  • Time to rest and reset. Self-directed vacation (most teammates take 4–6 weeks annually), monthly Acuity Days (a collective Friday off), plus a two-week company-wide closure each December.
  • Comprehensive care. Health benefits from day one for you and your dependents.
  • Future-focused support. A 2% GRSP matching program to help you plan ahead.
  • Support for growing families. A 16-week parental leave top-up beyond EI, available to all parents.

What Happens After You Apply

We review every application carefully. Whether you apply directly, are referred, or connect through a recruiter or hiring manager, you’ll receive equal consideration.

We don’t use AI to evaluate applications, though you may be automatically screened out if you don’t meet baseline requirements (e.g. Canadian residency and valid work authorization). In some interviews, AI may help with note-taking, but all evaluations and decisions are made by real humans.

Our interviews are two-way conversations. We want to understand your career, abilities, and goals, and help you assess whether this opportunity and team are the right fit for you.

Steps in the Process

Our hiring process typically takes 2–4 weeks from initial conversation to final decision.

  • Application Review. A real person reviews your application for potential fit.
  • Intro Conversation. A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn about your career journey, what you’re looking for next, and to introduce you to Acuity, Casper, and the role.
  • Hiring Manager Conversation. A conversation about how you build trusted customer relationships, navigate ambiguity, and balance customer outcomes with commercial success. You’ll also have the opportunity to learn more about the evolution of Customer Success at Acuity, the portfolio you’ll support, and the challenges we’re working to solve alongside our partners.
  • Team Conversations. You’ll meet members of our Customer Success and Growth Enablement & Execution teams to explore how we work together across the customer journey. It’s also an opportunity for you to ask questions, get to know future teammates, and see what it would be like to work together day to day.
  • Decision. The hiring manager reviews feedback from the interview team and typically makes a decision within 2 to 4 business days.
  • Offer & Reference Checks. If it’s a match, we’ll move to references and a formal offer.

Life at Acuity Insights

We’re a remote-first team of 140+ people who care deeply about our work and about each other.

Our culture is intentionally designed. As we’ve grown, we’ve made deliberate choices about how we work together, prioritizing trust, flexibility, and a sustainable pace so people can do meaningful work over the long term.

That commitment has been recognized externally. Acuity Insights has been named one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for the second consecutive year, reflecting our focus on building a strong, people-first environment.

Day to day, that shows up in how we collaborate:

  • High trust and autonomy in how work gets done
  • Thoughtful, async-friendly communication across a distributed team
  • Space for deep work, balanced with intentional moments of connection
  • A culture grounded in care, curiosity, and shared purpose

As we continue to grow, we’re focused on maintaining that balance, building a company where people can do their best work and grow over time, without losing what makes the environment feel human.

About Acuity Insights

Acuity Insights builds products that help higher education institutions make better decisions about people, from admissions through to development.

Our work is grounded in a simple idea: that people are more than their grades, and that potential can be understood and developed, not just measured.

Our Casper situational judgment test (SJT), created by researchers at McMaster University, has been completed by over 1 million applicants and is one of the most widely used open-response SJTs in higher education, backed by nearly 20 years of research.

Today, we are evolving our products to better connect assessment, insight, and development, helping institutions not just identify potential, but actively support its growth over time.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.


A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 5% or lower client churn
  • Manage 8-10 mid level clients
  • Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.
  • Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.

Become a part of our caring community

The Fraud and Waste Professional 2 conducts investigations of allegations of fraudulent and abusive practices. The Fraud and Waste Professional 2 work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action.

Where You Come In

The Fraud and Waste Professional 2 coordinates investigation with internal and external entities including compliance, internal business partners, and law enforcement. Assembles evidence and documentation to support successful adjudication, where appropriate. Prepares complex investigative and audit reports. Understands department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas. Makes decisions regarding own work methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations, and requires minimal direction and receives guidance where needed. Follows established guidelines/procedures.

What Humana Offers
We are fortunate to offer a remote opportunity for this job. Our Fortune 100 Company values associate engagement & your well-being. We also provide excellent professional development & continued education


Use your skills to make an impact

WORK STYLE: Remote anywhere in US, work at home. While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

WORK HOURS: Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day, 5 days/week, ideally, associates will work on EST (regardless of their home time zone). Must start between 6AM-9AM (in the employee's time zone), some flexibility might be possible, depending on business needs.

Job Title: Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant (Dental)

Position type: Full-Time

Work hours: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Daylight Time

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $8 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

About the role

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and patient-focused Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant (Dental) to provide front-desk, scheduling, insurance, and administrative support for a busy U.S.-based dental practice.

This is a patient-facing role that requires fluency in both English and Spanish, excellent phone communication skills, and the ability to confidently manage a high volume of patient interactions throughout the day. You will serve as an important point of contact for patients, helping them schedule appointments, understand treatment-related costs, complete necessary follow-ups, and navigate insurance-related processes.

In addition to virtual reception responsibilities, you will support insurance verification, treatment plan preparation, co-payment collection, claim creation, and coordination with the practice's external billing company. You will also help keep the appointment schedule organized and ensure patient communications and administrative tasks are handled accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate has previous dental or healthcare administrative experience and understands the importance of balancing efficiency with compassionate patient service. Dentrix experience is highly preferred, while familiarity with Delta Dental and Weave is a significant advantage.

We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to become a long-term member of the team. The practice values quality, accuracy, professionalism, and finding the right person for the role rather than simply filling the position quickly.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Virtual Reception & Patient Communication

  • Answer and manage a high volume of inbound patient calls professionally
  • Serve as a friendly and knowledgeable first point of contact for patients
  • Respond to patient questions and route inquiries appropriately
  • Manage patient communications through the Weave phone and communication platform
  • Maintain a professional, compassionate, and patient-focused approach during every interaction

Appointment Scheduling & Patient Follow-Up

  • Schedule, confirm, and reschedule patient appointments
  • Maintain an organized and optimized appointment schedule
  • Conduct patient follow-ups regarding appointments and treatment plans
  • Help reduce scheduling gaps and ensure appropriate follow-up is completed
  • Follow practice-specific scripts, workflows, and scheduling procedures

Insurance Verification & Treatment Coordination

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits, primarily through Delta Dental
  • Review relevant insurance information before appointments
  • Prepare treatment plans with detailed fee and patient cost breakdowns
  • Communicate treatment-related financial information clearly and professionally
  • Collect patient co-payments according to practice procedures

Claims & Billing Coordination

  • Create insurance claims for submission and coordination with the external billing service
  • Coordinate with the practice's billing company regarding claim processing and follow-ups
  • Maintain accurate insurance and billing-related documentation
  • Follow up on outstanding information when necessary to keep claims moving efficiently

Administrative Support

  • Maintain accurate and organized patient information within Dentrix
  • Provide general front-desk and administrative support
  • Complete assigned documentation and patient-related administrative tasks
  • Learn and consistently follow the practice's customized workflows, scripts, policies, and procedures
  • Assist the team with additional administrative responsibilities as needed

Top 3 Priorities

1. Virtual Reception & Call Management

Provide professional bilingual phone coverage, manage a high volume of inbound patient calls, address inquiries, and ensure patients receive timely and helpful assistance.

2. Patient Follow-Up & Administrative Support

Manage scheduling, appointment confirmations, treatment plan follow-ups, and day-to-day administrative responsibilities while maintaining an organized patient experience.

3. Insurance Verification & Billing Coordination

Verify insurance eligibility and benefits, prepare treatment-related cost information, create claims, collect co-payments, and coordinate effectively with the external billing team.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

Bilingual Communication

  • Fluency in both English and Spanish is required
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills in both languages
  • Confident communicating with patients over the phone
  • Able to explain scheduling, insurance, treatment, and payment information clearly and professionally
  • Compassionate and patient-focused communication style

Dental & Healthcare Administrative Experience

  • Previous dental or healthcare administrative experience is strongly preferred
  • Experience in a patient-facing dental or medical office role is highly desirable
  • Experience supporting a U.S.-based dental or healthcare practice is preferred
  • Familiarity with dental front-desk workflows, scheduling, treatment coordination, or insurance processes is a strong advantage

Scheduling & Patient Support

  • Experience managing appointment scheduling, confirmations, rescheduling, and patient follow-ups
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of calls and appointments
  • Strong customer service and patient interaction skills
  • Ability to stay calm, organized, and professional during busy periods

Dental Insurance & Billing Coordination

  • Experience with insurance eligibility and benefits verification
  • Comfortable navigating insurance portals and reviewing patient coverage
  • Experience preparing or supporting treatment plans and patient cost breakdowns
  • Comfortable collecting co-payments and discussing patient financial responsibility professionally
  • Experience creating insurance claims and coordinating with billing teams is strongly preferred
  • Comfortable working with an external billing service and following up on insurance-related tasks

Systems & Software Experience

The practice currently uses:

  • Dentrix – Primary dental practice management/EHR system
  • Delta Dental – Primary insurance platform for eligibility and benefits verification
  • Weave – Phone and patient communication platform

Hands-on Dentrix experience is highly preferred. Familiarity with Delta Dental and Weave is also a significant advantage.

Candidates should be tech-savvy, quick to learn, and comfortable adapting to the practice's customized systems and workflows.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Experienced in dental or healthcare administration
  • Confident handling high-volume patient calls
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
  • Comfortable with insurance verification and billing coordination
  • Professional and compassionate when communicating with patients
  • Proactive and able to anticipate administrative needs
  • Reliable, dependable, and consistent
  • Able to multitask effectively in a busy dental environment
  • A quick learner who follows instructions and established processes carefully
  • Comfortable working independently while remaining collaborative with the practice team
  • Interested in a stable, long-term opportunity
  • Fully committed to the required Monday through Friday work schedule

Basic Requirements

  • Must be fluent in both English and Spanish
  • Must have relevant dental, healthcare, or administrative work experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAdlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so that enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack.

For insurance carriers, that means agentic intake across the documents that drive the business: FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions, endorsements and certificates. Adlib classifies, extracts, validates and scores each document for trust, then hands clean data to the core systems and AI models already in place. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.

On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply carrier rules, route the exception and trigger the next action in the workflow. The document layer establishes trust in the data. The agentic layer acts on it. Together they take work out of the claim file rather than simply digitizing it.

We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design. We sit in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens, Majesco and the rest of the core stack rather than replacing any of it. Adlib is backed by Diversis Capital and serves Fortune 1000 customers across insurance, life sciences and public sector.

Who you are

You have sold enterprise software into insurance and you know the difference between selling to a Chief Claims Officer and selling to IT. You can walk into a claims operation, understand where documents create leakage and cycle time, and translate that into a business case a COO will sign.

You are a hunter. This is a new logo territory build across North America, focused on mid-market and upper mid-market carriers, MGAs, TPAs and brokers, with cross-sell into the existing base. You want the ownership that comes with an open field, and you are comfortable being measured on it.

You are credible in an AI conversation without overpromising. Our biggest competitive risk is being boxed as "just another OCR or IDP tool." You will need to hold the line on the trust layer and agentic intake story, in front of buyers who have been pitched by every extraction vendor in the market and are now being pitched agentic AI by their core platform vendor as well.

The details

Role

Account Executive, Insurance

Territory

North America (United States and Canada)

Reports to

General Manager, Insurance

Location

Remote, North America. Approximately 30% travel.

Target start date

September 15, 2026

Base salary

$125,000 – 145,000 USD

What you will own


  • Build and own the North America insurance new logo territory. Source, qualify and close new business against a $1M annual new ARR target, with a disciplined focus on the ~15 named ABM accounts in the insurance vertical plus self-sourced expansion.
  • Executive access. Run multi-threaded deals across Claims, Underwriting, Operations, IT and Data or AI leadership. Reach and hold the attention of Chief Claims Officers, Chief Underwriting Officers, COOs, CIOs and Chief Data Officers.
  • Domain depth. Become fluent in how claims and underwriting actually run: FNOL and loss intake, adjuster workflows, subrogation, SIU and fraud referral, submission triage, policy issuance and endorsements, and the document handoffs that slow each one down.
  • Technical fluency. Understand where Adlib sits relative to the core platform. Be able to whiteboard the flow from document intake through validation and agentic routing into Guidewire ClaimCenter or Duck Creek, and explain what changes for the adjuster and the underwriter.

  • Sell the agentic intake story on business outcomes, not model hype. Defend the trust and governance layer against core platform vendors and extraction point tools now claiming the same ground.
  • Partner leverage. Work with our Strategic Partnerships lead and the insurance SI ecosystem, including Guidewire-connected implementation partners, to source and co-sell partner-originated opportunities.
  • Forecast rigor. Keep Salesforce clean and your forecast honest. Weekly pipeline and forecast discipline is non-negotiable, and the number you call is the number we take to the Board.
  • Land and expand. Land a first use case, prove trust and accuracy against a defined baseline, then expand across lines of business and adjacent processes.

What you bring

  • Insurance sales experience. 5+ years closing complex enterprise software into insurance carriers, MGAs, TPAs, brokers or reinsurers, with a track record of quota attainment at or above $1M in new ARR.
  • Core process knowledge. Direct experience selling into or working within claims, underwriting, policy administration or compliance functions. You understand the claims lifecycle end to end and can speak to loss ratio, expense ratio, cycle time, leakage and straight-through processing.
  • Systems familiarity. Working familiarity with the insurance core and content stack: Guidewire (ClaimCenter, PolicyCenter, BillingCenter), Duck Creek, Sapiens, Majesco, Origami Risk or Insurity, plus content platforms such as OnBase, ImageRight, FileNet or SharePoint. You do not need to configure them. You do need to know how data moves through them.
  • Data and regulatory context. Comfort with ACORD forms and standards, ISO forms, unstructured claim and submission documents, and the data quality problems that come with them. Awareness of NAIC and state DOI expectations, HIPAA where health data is in scope, and audit and retention requirements.

  • You can craft and deliver a business case, not a feature tour. You can present to a room of C-level executives and to a technical evaluation team on the same day, and be equally credible in both.

  • Disciplined use of a structured sales methodology (MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or equivalent), with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling AI, intelligent document processing, RPA or data platform solutions into insurance.
  • Existing relationships with insurance systems integrators and Guidewire or Duck Creek implementation partners.
  • Experience selling in a private equity backed environment with a clear growth mandate.
  • Canadian market experience alongside the United States.
  • Prior work at a carrier, MGA or TPA in claims or underwriting operations.

What is in it for you

Adlib’s headquarters are located in Burlington, Ontario, and this role is remote within North America. We care about employee health and wellness and develop programs that align to achieving personal and professional satisfaction. We are also passionate about our community and participate in many local charitable events.

We believe that maximizing work-life balance is one of the most important paths to high performance. To that end, we have an open vacation policy and many programs to promote employee wellness.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.description:
Customer Service Representative / Dispatcher (Home Services) – Remote

Customer Service | Dispatch Coordination | ServiceTitan | Home Services

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Service Representative / Dispatcher to serve as the primary point of contact for customers while coordinating technician schedules and dispatch operations for a growing home services business.

This is a fast-paced, customer-facing role where you’ll manage inbound inquiries, schedule service appointments, coordinate field technicians, and ensure customers receive timely updates throughout the service process. You’ll play a vital role in keeping daily operations running efficiently while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

The ideal candidate has previous experience supporting HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home service companies, thrives under pressure, and is highly organized with excellent communication skills.

What You’ll Own

Customer Service & Client Communication

  • Answer inbound customer calls, emails, and service inquiries professionally.
  • Assist customers with appointment scheduling, service updates, and general inquiries.
  • Resolve customer concerns with empathy while escalating complex issues when appropriate.
  • Respond to customer messages across multiple communication channels, including social media.
  • Deliver a positive customer experience throughout every interaction.

Scheduling & Dispatch Coordination

  • Schedule service appointments accurately using ServiceTitan.
  • Coordinate technician schedules and dispatch field technicians efficiently.
  • Manage appointment changes, cancellations, and emergency service requests.
  • Ensure technicians receive complete and accurate job information before dispatch.
  • Optimize technician schedules to maximize efficiency and service quality.

Service Operations Support

  • Review incoming service requests and ensure all jobs are properly scheduled.
  • Monitor active work orders and open service tickets.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, notes, and follow-up tasks.
  • Ensure no customer requests or appointments fall through the cracks.
  • Support daily operational workflows to improve service delivery.

Administrative & Reporting Support

  • Maintain accurate documentation within ServiceTitan and internal systems.
  • Update customer records, dispatch notes, and operational logs.
  • Assist with reporting, tracking, and operational follow-up activities.
  • Support internal teams with administrative tasks related to dispatch and customer service.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • Previous experience in Customer Service and Dispatch roles.
  • Experience supporting HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Home Services, or Trade Services companies.
  • Experience handling high-volume inbound customer calls.
  • Strong understanding of scheduling and dispatch operations.
  • Experience coordinating emergency or urgent service requests.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with ServiceTitan.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based home service companies.
  • Experience handling customer communication through social media platforms.
  • Additional customer service or dispatch certifications.
  • Experience using other CRM or field service management platforms.

Tools & Platforms

  • ServiceTitan
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • CRM & Service Management Platforms
  • Microsoft Office
  • Google Workspace

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly organized with excellent multitasking abilities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Calm, solution-oriented, and composed during busy periods.
  • Takes ownership of issues and follows through until resolution.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, customer-focused environments.
  • Comfortable coordinating both customers and field technicians simultaneously.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review incoming service requests and technician schedules.
  • Answer customer inquiries and schedule appointments.
  • Dispatch technicians to service calls.
  • Coordinate schedule adjustments and emergency requests.
  • Update customer records and service notes.
  • Communicate with technicians throughout the day.
  • Monitor open work orders and ensure timely completion.
  • Support daily operational reporting and administrative tasks.

In short: You ensure customers receive timely, professional service while keeping technician schedules organized and dispatch operations running smoothly.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Appointment scheduling accuracy
  • Technician utilization and schedule efficiency
  • Customer satisfaction and response times
  • Call handling efficiency
  • Dispatch accuracy
  • Timely follow-up and task completion
  • Accuracy of ServiceTitan documentation and operational records

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity with a growing home services organization.
  • High-impact role supporting daily field operations.
  • Fast-paced environment with strong ownership and responsibility.
  • Opportunity to develop expertise in dispatch operations and customer service.
  • Career growth into Operations, Dispatch Management, or Customer Success leadership roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Customer Service Representative and Dispatcher who enjoys helping customers, coordinating field operations, and keeping fast-paced service teams running efficiently, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key part of a growing home services team.

jobs.excerpt: About PacasoPacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people.
jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

  • No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking
  • Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)
  • Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation
  • Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)
  • Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)
  • LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

Social & Influencer StrategistThe Social & Influencer Strategist owns Pacaso's social presence and influencer strategy end to end, bringing a strong point of view, a data-driven mindset, and experience growing audience, reach, and engagement through effective social tactics and AI tools. This role requires experience working with high-end, luxury brands and the ability to translate that fluency into social content that reads as elevated and intentional.

The Strategist operates as an expert in social strategy, building a content calendar grounded in performance data. Fluency in social listening tools, data analysis, and social platforms such as Hootsuite is required. This person will also be proficient in AI tools, (we use Claude here!) and building AI systems for social frameworks. This role also requires experience developing and running influencer programs and is expected to own that function fully, from creator identification through negotiation and campaign management.

This role sits on the brand team alongside content production, which is owned by Pacaso's Creative team. While content creation is not the main responsibility, this role does require a strong visual eye: sharp instincts for photo selection, working knowledge of high-end photography and editing, and the ability to edit video content.

Core Responsibilities

Social Strategy and Growth

  • Develop Pacaso's foundational social strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, and YouTube, with a channel-specific approach to content, format, and voice rather than a single asset repurposed across every platform
  • Conduct ongoing social listening and trend tracking across the luxury, design, travel, wealth, and wellness landscape, translating findings into brand-right recommendations for growth; partner cross-functionally with PR and Sales to ensure social strategy stays aligned with broader brand and business priorities
  • Report out on performance on a standard cadence, with new initiatives defined based on trends and insights. Bring new ideas and recommendations to marketing leadership with a clear point of view and the data to support it.
  • Use AI tools, social listening platforms, and performance analytics to inform content, campaign, and growth decisions

Content & Cadence

  • Run a daily publishing rhythm across all social channels, including proactive scheduling and management through Hootsuite or similar social management tools
  • Maintain fluency in Pacaso's brand voice, messaging pillars, and underlying brand story, applying that understanding consistently across all content
  • Collaborating with the brand and production team, as well as Product team, maintain a content calendar populated at least two weeks ahead at all times, working independently and bringing fresh ideas to the table

Influencer Strategy, Brand Partnerships, and Executive Communications

  • Build Pacaso's influencer program from the ground up: identify, source, and vet creators in the luxury, design, travel, economics/entrepreneur/wealth, and wellness spaces
  • Own outreach, rate negotiation, contracting, briefing, content development, and campaign management through delivery and reporting
  • Develop a collaboration pipeline with high-end brands and names
  • Manage and write LinkedIn content for Pacaso's CEO, along with additional thought leadership content as needed

Community & Reporting

  • Monitor and engage with Pacaso's social communities, responding to comments and DMs in an authentic, brand-aligned way
  • Own performance reporting and run regular competitive analysis, bringing findings forward with clear, actionable recommendations

Candidates should have:

  • Experience running social for a brand where the bar was high and the audience was discerning- luxury, design, hospitality, real estate, travel, premium consumer
  • A strong, well-formed point of view on brand and content, with the confidence to advocate for it and push back when needed
  • Proven proficiency in building AI-driven workflows and advanced experience working with a wide range of AI tools to optimize social strategy and content creation
  • Direct experience negotiating with influencers and their representation; experience managing influencer agency relationships a plus
  • Fluency in performance data, with the ability to translate it into a clear recommendation, not just a report
  • Strong, concise writing skills, with the range to write convincingly in a brand's or executive's voice
  • Experience operating independently at a senior level, with the judgment to build systems rather than rely on oversight
  • A genuine expert in social platforms and emerging formats, with curiosity and enthusiasm toward testing new tools and methods
  • Experience working alongside sales teams, using social as a true tool to increase and improve conversion rates
  • Working knowledge of media monitoring tools and practices, and genuine fluency in how PR and press coverage intersect with brand and social strategy

Compensation

  • Around $125,000 with equity

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

  • Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building
  • Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare
  • 401(k) to help you build long-term security
  • Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers
  • Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work
  • Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment

Our Commitment

Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Design
jobs.excerpt: At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.
jobs.description:
At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact, who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose, this is your place.


Responsibilities

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer who takes ownership of the end-to-end experience within their squad, combining product thinking, data analysis, and craft to deliver solutions that work for users and drive business results.

What you'll do

  • Partner with PMs and engineers to define product strategy and shape experiences grounded in user needs and business goals;
  • Identify improvement opportunities proactively, formulating hypotheses and designing data-driven experiments to validate them;
  • Translate data-research findings and analytics into tangible product decisions;
  • Use AI tools actively to accelerate concept generation, iterate faster, and improve the quality of UX writing and design decisions;
  • Contribute to the Design System, maintaining and expanding it as the product evolves;
  • Collaborate across the UX team, including writers, frontend engineers, and DesignOps;
  • Raise the bar for design quality, with solid command of UI, usability, and interaction patterns;
  • Document your process and share knowledge with the team.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in Product Design, ideally within the Brazilian financial ecosystem;
  • Strong grasp of the end-to-end design process, with emphasis on fast prototyping and experimentation;
  • Ability to identify and prioritize opportunities, create experiments, and define success metrics collaboratively;
  • Fluency with AI tools as part of the daily design workflow, not as a novelty but as a productivity and quality multiplier;
  • Clear communication with cross-functional teams, especially engineering;
  • Familiarity with accessibility best practices and multi-device UX;
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in fast-paced, interdisciplinary environments;
  • Ability to present and defend design decisions to senior leadership and C-level stakeholders;
  • Owner mentality: business-oriented, data-driven, and accountable for results.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Industry-Specific Knowledge

It is desirable to have practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, along with an understanding of their fundamental workflows and business drivers. Experience in how these domains intersect to influence revenue, risk management, and customer satisfaction is highly valued.

Ideally, candidates will have applied this knowledge to deliver solutions such as loan-origination engines with real-time decisioning; scalable payment-processing platforms integrated with core banking systems and third-party gateways; secure open-finance interfaces compliant with industry regulations; automated fraud-detection pipelines leveraging behavioral analytics; or financial reporting and reconciliation engines for regulatory compliance. The ability to translate complex compliance mandates (e.g., KYC/AML, PCI-DSS, GDPR) into resilient, high-performance systems without compromising user experience is considered a strong asset.
