jobs.title: Directeur médical adjoint-oncologie/ Associate Medical Director-Oncology (CAN)
jobs.excerpt: Chez Allucent™, nous nous engageons à aider les petites et moyennes entreprises biopharmaceutiques à naviguer efficacement dans l’univers complexe des essais cliniques afin d’offrir des traitements qui changent la vie aux patients qui en ont besoin partout dans le monde.
jobs.description:
Chez Allucent™, nous nous engageons à aider les petites et moyennes entreprises biopharmaceutiques à naviguer efficacement dans l’univers complexe des essais cliniques afin d’offrir des traitements qui changent la vie aux patients qui en ont besoin partout dans le monde.

At Allucent™, we are dedicated to helping small-medium biopharmaceutical companies efficiently navigate the complex world of clinical trials to bring life-changing therapies to patients in need across the globe.

Nous recherchons un directeur médical adjoint pour rejoindre notre équipe d’élite (télétravail). En tant que directeur médical adjoint chez Allucent, vous serez chargé de veiller, de manière autonome, à l’intégrité et à la qualité des aspects médicaux, cliniques et de sécurité des essais menés par Allucent. Vous servirez de personne-ressource en tant que moniteur médical dans les protocoles d’étude auprès des chercheurs et des équipes des centres d’étude pour toute question relative au protocole et à la sécurité des participants recrutés. Une expérience en oncologie est obligatoire pour ce poste.

We are looking for an Associate Medical Director to join our A-team (remote). As an Associate Medical Director at Allucent, you are responsible for working independently to ensure the medical/clinical and safety integrity and quality of trials conducted by Allucent, serving as the medical monitor contact in study protocols to investigators and study sites team regarding protocol related questions and safety of the subjects enrolled. Experience in Oncology is a requirement for this position.

Dans le cadre de ce poste, vos principales tâches consisteront à:

  • Fournir de manière autonome un soutien en matière de surveillance médicale aux études cliniques qui vous sont attribuées, par exemple en répondant aux questions d’ordre médical posées par l’équipe de l’étude et/ou le site, en aidant à l’interprétation du protocole et à l’examen médical des données générées, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, les données de laboratoire clinique et les formulaires de rapport de cas, selon les besoins, afin de garantir le respect du protocole, la cohérence et la validité scientifique des données. Au besoin, et avec l’appui nécessaire de ses supérieurs, aider le gestionnaire de projet dans les discussions avec les clients concernant les questions ou les préoccupations liées à la sécurité qui pourraient avoir été soulevées.
  • Préparer les plans de surveillance médicale et autres plans pertinents pour les études assignées menées par Allucent avant le début de l’étude et conformément aux livrables prévus dans le contrat.
  • Examiner les événements indésirables graves, les SUSAR, les rapports de sécurité et effectuer l’analyse des événements similaires.
  • Assister l’équipe de gestion des données cliniques dans le codage MedDRA et OMS pour les essais assignés.
  • Contribuer à l’examen des documents relatifs aux études cliniques afin d’en vérifier la cohérence et la pertinence sur le plan médical, avec l’appui des membres chevronnés de l’équipe médicale au besoin, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter, le protocole d’essai clinique (CTP), le formulaire de consentement éclairé (ICF) et le rapport d’étude clinique (CSR), ainsi que d’autres rapports sur l’innocuité (p. ex., DSUR, PSUR)
  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à la conduite des comités de sécurité des données (DSMB, DMB ou équivalents) et des réunions d’augmentation de la dose (DEC)
  • Assister, participer et faire des présentations lors de la réunion de lancement, de la réunion des chercheurs et d’autres réunions pertinentes dans le cadre des projets attribués, selon les besoins.
  • Fournir un soutien médical d’urgence 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, pour des conseils médicaux et de sécurité, au besoin
  • Assurer la formation des équipes de projet sur les aspects médicaux de l’essai et la formation thérapeutique, au besoin
  • Examen des écarts par rapport au protocole
  • Cerner les risques liés à l’étude et contribuer à l’élaboration du plan de gestion des risques
  • Examiner et comprendre les livrables médicaux de l’étude tels qu’ils sont définis dans le contrat de l’étude assignée, avec l’appui de collègues plus expérimentés, et contribuer au suivi des dépenses budgétaires tout au long des études qui leur sont confiées
  • Assiste à d’importantes conférences sur les traitements thérapeutiques et le développement de médicaments, et peut être amené à y faire une présentation
  • Assure une bonne communication et entretient de bonnes relations avec les (futurs) clients
  • Contribue et participe, avec le soutien de collègues plus expérimentés si nécessaire, aux évaluations des clients, aux visites et aux présentations d’offres

In this role your key tasks will include:

  • Independently provide medical monitor support to assigned clinical studies, for example answering medical questions from study team and/or site, assist with protocol interpretation and medical review of generated data including but not limited to clinical laboratory data and case report forms as necessary to ensure adherence to the protocol, consistency and scientific validity of the data. When appropriate, and with the necessary support from senior colleagues, assist the Project Manager in discussions with clients on safety issues or concerns that may have arisen
  • Prepare the Medical Monitoring and other relevant plans for assigned studies conducted by Allucent prior to the start of the study and in accordance to deliverables contracted.
  • Review Serious Adverse Events, SUSARs, safety narratives and perform Analysis of Similar Events
  • Assist clinical data management with MedDRA and WHO coding in assigned trials
  • Assist by reviewing clinical study documents for medical consistency and relevance, with support of senior medical team members if needed, including but not limited to the clinical trial protocol (CTP), the Informed Consent (ICF) and clinical study report (CSR) other safety reports (e.g., DSUR, PSUR)
  • Assist in the set up and conduct of Data Safety Boards (DSMB, DMB or similar) and Dose escalation meetings (DEC)
  • Attend, participate and present in Kick-Off, Investigators’ meeting, and other relevant meetings in assigned projects, as requested.
  • Provide 24/7 urgent medical support for medical and safety advice if required
  • Training of project teams on medical aspects of the trial and therapeutic training as required
  • Review of Protocol Deviations
  • Identify study risks and provide input to the Risk plan
  • Review and understand study medical deliverables laid down in the assigned study’s contract with support of senior colleagues and help track budget spent throughout their assigned study(ies)
  • Attends and may need to present at major therapeutic conferences and drug development conferences
  • Assure good communication and relationships with (future) clients
  • Contribute and take part with support from senior colleagues as needed in client evaluations, visits and bid defenses

Requirements

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devrez posséder :

  • Un diplôme de docteur en médecine (MD)
  • Expérience en tant qu’oncologue
  • au moins trois ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente, avec une solide expertise en oncologie
  • Une bonne connaissance des normes GxP
  • Une situation en règle auprès des autorités de réglementation et d’agrément locales, provinciales (aux États-Unis) et nationales, ainsi qu’auprès des organismes de certification
  • Connaissance des exigences réglementaires applicables (locales), notamment celles du RGPD/HIPAA, du CFR/CTR/CTD
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, y compris une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais
  • Présentable, extraverti et axé sur le client
  • Capacité à travailler dans l’environnement dynamique et stimulant d’une entreprise en pleine croissance
  • Excellence administrative
  • Maîtrise requise de divers logiciels tels que Word, Excel et PowerPoint

To be successful you will possess:

  • MD degree
  • Experience as an Oncologist
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience with solid Oncology expertise
  • Good knowledge of GxP
  • Good standing with local, state (in the US), and national licensing and regulatory authorities and certifying bodies
  • GDPR/HIPAA, CFR/CTR/CTD and applicable (local) regulatory requirements understanding
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language
  • Representative, outgoing and client focused
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced challenging environment of a growing company
  • Administrative excellence
  • Proficiency with various computer applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required

Benefits

Voici quelques-uns des avantages liés au fait de travailler chez Allucent :

  • Ensemble complet d’avantages sociaux selon le lieu de travail
  • Salaires concurrentiels selon le lieu de travail
  • Budget de formation et d’études alloué par service pour favoriser le perfectionnement professionnel
  • Horaires de travail flexibles (dans la mesure du raisonnable)
  • Possibilité de travail à distance ou hybride* selon le lieu de travail
  • Possibilités d’accéder à des postes de direction et de bénéficier d’un mentorat
  • Participation à notre programme de jumelage, que ce soit en tant que nouvel employé ou employé déjà en poste
  • Possibilités d’évolution interne et de progression de carrière
  • Programme de recommandation de candidats par les employés, financièrement avantageux
  • Accès à des formations en ligne sur les compétences générales et techniques via ADP et nos plateformes internes
  • Admissibilité à notre programme de primes ponctuelles, qui récompense les efforts exceptionnels déployés dans le cadre de projets
  • Admissibilité à notre programme de récompenses de fidélité, qui reconnaît la loyauté et l’engagement des employés de longue date

Avertissements :

Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison (Mortgage Operations) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to manage loan files and ensure they move efficiently from submission through closing.

You’ll serve as the primary coordination point between lenders, underwriters, and internal teams, maintaining clear visibility across every active loan and ensuring documentation, conditions, follow-ups, and deadlines stay on track.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in:

  • Mortgage operations
  • Loan processing
  • Loan coordination
  • Lender communication

jobs.excerpt: Suppliers remember two things about a business: whether it pays correctly, and whether it pays on time.
jobs.description:
Suppliers remember two things about a business: whether it pays correctly, and whether it pays on time. You will be the reason the answer is yes to both.

Job Overview

Our UK-based client is hiring a full-time, remote Accounts Payable Clerk based in South Africa. You will own the purchase ledger: capturing invoices, matching them to orders, resolving queries and preparing payment runs with clockwork reliability. This is a long-term role on UK business hours.

About Our Client

The client is an established UK business with steady supplier volumes and a finance team that values accuracy over drama. They want a payables professional who treats the ledger as their own - clean, current and audit-ready at any moment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Capture and code supplier invoices accurately into the accounting system
  • Match invoices to purchase orders and delivery notes, investigating mismatches
  • Reconcile supplier statements and resolve queries promptly
  • Prepare weekly and monthly payment runs for approval
  • Maintain clean vendor records and chase missing documentation
  • Support month-end close with accruals and ledger housekeeping
  • Flag duplicate, unusual or suspicious invoices before they cost money

What You Will Be Doing Day-to-Day

Your day starts with the invoice inbox: capturing, coding and routing everything that arrived overnight. You will work through matching exceptions, contact suppliers about discrepancies, and keep the query log short and honest.

As payment runs approach you will prepare schedules, double-check details, and make sure approvals happen on time. At month-end you will reconcile statements and hand the ledger to the accountant in a state that needs no apology.

This suits a South African professional who is precise, methodical and quietly proud of a clean ledger. You know the difference between fast and rushed - and you never confuse the two with other people's money.

If you are based in South Africa with solid payables experience and good English, this is a stable remote career with a UK employer that respects careful finance work. Apply today.

Requirements

  • 2+ years' experience in accounts payable or bookkeeping
  • Good written and spoken English for supplier and team communication
  • Proven reliability: stable fibre internet, backup power for load shedding, and a quiet home office
  • Confident with tech tools: Xero, Sage or QuickBooks, plus Excel or Google Sheets
  • Meticulous accuracy with numbers, coding and reconciliations
  • Trustworthy, deadline-driven and calm under month-end pressure

Benefits

Full-time remote position working for a UK-based employer. Competitive salary paid in ZAR. Long-term stable role. Supportive team environment. Direct access to founder-led business.

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber's network runs on infrastructure — the compute, hypervisors, databases, containers, and bare metal platforms that power everything from network functions and OSS/BSS systems to subscriber-facing services. The Principal Architect for Infrastructure is the technical authority for this entire stack. This role will lead the VMware-to-OpenStack migration, define our containerization and orchestration strategy, architect redundant and geographically diverse compute environments, and ensure every platform we run meets carrier-grade reliability standards.

This is a hands-on senior independent contributor role. You will set the standards, own the architecture, and work directly with engineering teams to design and deliver infrastructure that is scalable, automated, and built for operational independence.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Virtualization & Compute

●Own the hypervisor and private cloud strategy: OpenStack/KVM architecture, cluster topology, and operational model — including the full migration program from VMware.

●Define Proxmox deployment architecture for environments requiring lightweight, flexible virtualization: cluster design, storage integration, and operational standards.

●Architect bare metal server infrastructure: provisioning automation, lifecycle management, firmware governance, and integration with virtualization and container platforms.

●Lead the VMware → OpenStack migration program: workload inventory and assessment, migration sequencing, dependency mapping, and zero-impact cutover execution.

Containers & Orchestration

●Define and own the Kubernetes platform architecture: cluster design, networking (CNI), storage (CSI), RBAC, and multi-cluster strategy across on-premise and cloud environments.

●Establish Docker image lifecycle governance: base image standards, registry management, vulnerability scanning, and build pipeline integration.

●Design CI/CD pipeline for infrastructure and network function delivery: GitOps workflows, automated testing, and rollout orchestration using ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent.

Databases & Storage

●Own the database platform architecture: PostgreSQL deployment patterns, high-availability configuration (Patroni, pgBouncer, or equivalent), replication, backup, and disaster recovery.

●Define storage architecture across tiers: block (Ceph, iSCSI), object (S3-compatible), and file storage — with backup, replication, and RPO/RTO targets aligned to service criticality.

●Establish database governance standards: schema versioning, migration tooling, performance monitoring, and operational runbooks.

Cloud & Hybrid Architecture

●Define hybrid and multi-cloud integration patterns: workload placement strategy, cloud bursting, and private/public interconnect architecture (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or equivalent).

●Establish infrastructure-as-code standards across on-premise and cloud environments: Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent — with version control, peer review, and automated compliance checks.

Redundancy, Diversity & Resilience

●Own redundancy and geographic diversity planning for all infrastructure tiers: compute clusters, database platforms, storage, and network connectivity — with documented failure domain analysis and RTO/RPO targets for every critical system.

●Design active-active and active-passive architectures for carrier-grade availability: load balancing, failover automation, and health monitoring across sites.

●Define and test disaster recovery playbooks: regular DR exercises, runbook validation, and post-exercise gap remediation.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant infrastructure architecture experience.

·10+ years of infrastructure engineering with deep expertise in virtualization, private cloud, and data center operations in a network operator or telco environment.

·Demonstrated senior independent contributor experience setting infrastructure architecture standards, influencing technical direction, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-functional architecture decisions without direct people-management responsibility.

·Expert-level OpenStack knowledge: Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone — architecture, deployment, and operations at production scale.

·Hands-on Kubernetes experience: production cluster design, CNI/CSI selection, RBAC, and multi-cluster management.

·Strong PostgreSQL expertise: HA architecture, replication, performance tuning, and operational management in production environments.

·Proven VMware → OpenStack (or equivalent hypervisor migration) program delivery: workload assessment, migration tooling, and zero-impact cutover execution.

·Experience with bare metal provisioning and lifecycle management: Ironic, MAAS, or equivalent.

·Solid redundancy and diversity planning background: failure domain analysis, RTO/RPO definition, and DR program execution.

·Infrastructure-as-code proficiency: Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent in a network or telecom production environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

●Experience with Proxmox VE in production ISP or data center environments.

●Familiarity with DPDK, SR-IOV, or high-performance networking in virtualized environments for network function hosting.

●Experience with ETSI NFV/MANO frameworks and virtual network function (VNF) or cloud-native network function (CNF) onboarding.

●Prior work in co-location data center operations: power, cooling, cross-connect standards, and colo vendor management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Senior technical leadership skills with the ability to influence engineering direction, mentor technical teams, establish standards, and build alignment without direct people-management authority.

·Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills with the ability to balance reliability, scalability, security, operational independence, cost, and delivery risk.

·Executive presence and communication skills to explain complex infrastructure architecture decisions clearly and credibly to Technology, Operations, Finance, Security, vendors, and senior leadership.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

At all times, Ziply Fiber must be your primary employer. Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

Diverse Workforce / EEO:

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, and the presence of a non-job-related handicap or disability or any other legally protected status.

Ziply Fiber requires a pre-employment background check as conditions of employment. Ziply Fiber may require a pre-employment drug screening.

Ziply Fiber is a drug free workplace.

Travel Operations Specialist | Remote | Luxury Account

About Ascend

Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.

We have grown from 12 to 66 people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.

Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role

We are hiring a Travel Operations Specialist to take a confirmed flight booking and turn it into a complete, polished travel package delivered to the client.

Once a ticket has been issued by the Ticketing team, the booking comes to you. Your job is to build the full itinerary, prepare the invoice, confirm that payment has been received and recorded correctly, and send everything to the client with clarity and warmth. You also coordinate any extras the client needs, such as airport transfers, seat selections, or special meal preferences.

The client has trusted us with a high-value booking. What you send them is the moment they see the result of that trust. Everything needs to be accurate, professional, and exactly what was agreed.

Compensation

$500 - $600/month USD, depending on experience.

Compensation is reviewed based on performance, with clear milestones tied to progression.

What You'll Do

Building and Delivering the Trip

  • Prepare invoices using FreshBooks, our billing platform, following your Team Lead's instructions, and hold them for review before sending anything to the client
  • Once the itinerary and invoice are approved by your Team Lead, send them to the client with a warm, professional message in Periskope, our client communication platform

4. Future Administrative and Marketing Support

  • Communicate with attorneys by phone or email to follow up on patient cases and personal injury documentation when required.

  • Monitor and organize leads generated through SEO campaigns and external digital marketing platforms.

Work Schedule

This position follows a split-shift schedule designed to align with the clinic's operating hours.

Day

Working Hours in Eastern Time

Monday and Tuesday

9:00 AM to 1:30 PM and 2:45 PM to 6:45 PM

Wednesday

7:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Thursday

2:30 PM to 7:00 PM

Friday to Sunday

Flexible 2.5 hours total for brief check-ins and outstanding appointment requests

Candidates must be comfortable with the split-shift arrangement and available to consistently work during the required Eastern Time hours.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • At least one year of experience supporting a U.S.-based medical, wellness, or administrative clinic.

  • Advanced or near-native English verbal and written communication skills, with clear and professional phone communication.

  • Strong comprehension, active listening, multitasking, organization, and attention to detail.

Professional Skills

  • Ability to remain calm, grounded, and solution-oriented when assisting emotional, frustrated, or urgent patients.

  • Confidence managing phone calls, messages, appointment requests, paperwork, and administrative tasks simultaneously.

  • Ability to work independently, follow established workflows, protect patient confidentiality, and communicate proactively with a remote team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with a chiropractic office, wellness facility, or similar healthcare practice.

  • Familiarity with legal, attorney, personal injury, or patient case documentation.

  • Experience following up with marketing leads and converting prospective patients into scheduled appointments.

Tools and Platforms

Experience with all platforms is not required, but familiarity with healthcare, communication, and project management software is highly preferred.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is polished, patient-focused, resourceful, and highly dependable. You should be comfortable taking ownership of administrative responsibilities, communicating with patients throughout the day, and keeping information organized across several platforms.

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys supporting a small healthcare team, improving workflows, and helping create a smooth and welcoming experience for every patient.

Job Description:
The primary purpose of this position is to manage, maintain, implement, and improve cloud-focused, platform-agnostic IT infrastructure environments supporting Government customers and regulated workloads. This position focuses on secure cloud, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure Government/GCC High and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will have advanced technical expertise across multiple cloud platforms, the ability to design and operate secure Government cloud environments, experience applying compliance frameworks and security controls, and the ability to support mission-critical customer environments through participation in a 24x7 on-call rotation.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide operational support, administration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for Government customer cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments across Azure Government/GCC High, AWS GovCloud, and/or GCP.
  • Monitor, maintain, and optimize customer cloud environments to ensure availability, performance, security, compliance, and adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Perform incident, problem, change, and request management activities following established ITIL, security, compliance, and operational processes.
  • Respond to and resolve customer incidents, service requests, alerts, and operational issues across cloud compute, storage, networking, identity, security, automation, monitoring, backup, and platform services.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation supporting critical Government customer environments, including after-hours, weekends, holidays as required.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and remediation of complex cloud and infrastructure issues while driving preventative actions to improve reliability.
  • Support secure cloud operations by applying Government compliance requirements and security frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, and other applicable standards.
  • Manage and maintain cloud configurations, access controls, security controls, monitoring, logging, automation, and operational documentation.
  • Implement approved changes, upgrades, patches, migrations, and configuration updates while following established change management processes.
  • Develop and maintain automation, Infrastructure as Code, scripts, runbooks, knowledge articles, and operational procedures to improve efficiency and consistency.

jobs.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

This role sits on one of the largest database estates in the world, supporting one of our biggest clients — the kind of scale most infrastructure engineers never get direct access to. Changes made here don't touch one system, they touch a fleet, so the impact of good (and bad) engineering is outsized.

We're looking for an infrastructure/DevOps engineer to own the AWS platform our clients' RDS and Aurora databases run on — not the databases' internals. You'll manage the Terraform and CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Harness) that provisions them, maintain the supporting tooling that handles user and schema management, and be the escalation point when a team's Terraform, pipeline, or process has gone wrong. A big part of the job is making that go wrong less often: improving documentation, and building out the tooling that automatically routes support queries to the right place instead of everything landing on-call.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

Support & Troubleshooting:

Act as the escalation point when clients or internal teams break their Terraform, break their pipeline, or don't follow documented process — diagnose the actual problem and get them unblocked.

Write clear Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for significant incidents.

Infrastructure & Automation:

Build and maintain Terraform for provisioning AWS database infrastructure (RDS/Aurora), and the GitLab/Harness pipelines that deploy it.

Maintain the supporting tooling that manages database users and schemas, ensuring it stays correctly integrated with the databases it manages.

Automate recurring operational work with Python or Go.

Apply AWS security best practices — IAM roles, KMS encryption, Security Groups, Network ACLs — across managed environments.

Enablement & Tooling:

Build and improve the incident-response tooling so support queries get automatically routed to the right place, rather than landing on the person who is on call.

Own and improve documentation — runbooks, operational guides, disaster recovery procedures — so people stop making the same mistakes.

What we need from you:

  • 5+ Years of experience with AWS and Terraform in a production environment
  • Provisioning AWS infrastructure through a CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Github, Harness, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with RDS/Aurora operations — backup/restore, replication, disaster recovery — at the infrastructure level
  • Solid understanding of AWS security and compliance controls.
  • Experience automating operational tasks with Python or Go.
  • Proficiency in AWS networking (VPC, Subnets, Transit Gateways).
  • Comfortable being the person people come to when infrastructure or a pipeline is broken — clear communication under pressure, no hand-holding needed to trace a symptom to its root cause.
  • Nice to have: Docker, Vault, ProxySQL, and general relational database familiarity (MySQL or similar).

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). jobs.description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (Manual + Automation | SaaS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (flexibility for releases and sprints)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Tester) to ensure software products are thoroughly tested, reliable, and production-ready before release.

This is a hands-on QA role combining manual testing, test automation, defect management, API testing, and close collaboration with engineering teams.

You’ll act as a critical quality gate throughout the software development lifecycle — identifying bugs, validating fixes, testing edge cases, and helping prevent issues from reaching production.

If you naturally look for what could break, think through edge cases, and care deeply about delivering reliable software, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Planning & Coverage

  • Create and maintain:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test scenarios
    • Acceptance criteria
  • Define appropriate test coverage across new features, integrations, and regression flows.
  • Review requirements and identify potential gaps or risks before development is completed.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to ensure requirements are testable and clearly understood.

Manual Testing – Core Responsibility

  • Execute:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • Integration testing
    • UI/UX validation
    • Cross-browser testing
    • Cross-device testing
  • Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and edge cases before release.
  • Log and manage defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Provide developers with clear:
    • Reproduction steps
    • Expected vs. actual behavior
    • Screenshots or recordings
    • Environment details
  • Retest fixes and perform regression testing on impacted functionality.

Automation Testing

  • Build, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using tools such as:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Automate repetitive and high-value regression scenarios.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD workflows using:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
  • Investigate failed automated tests and distinguish product defects from test-script issues.

API & Performance Testing

  • Test APIs and backend functionality using Postman or similar tools.
  • Validate:
    • API responses
    • Status codes
    • Data integrity
    • Error handling
    • Integration behavior
  • Conduct performance, load, and stress testing using tools such as:
    • Apache JMeter
    • Locust
  • Support security and vulnerability testing where required.

Defect Tracking & Release Validation

  • Track bugs from discovery through resolution.
  • Prioritize issues based on severity, impact, and release risk.
  • Validate builds before production deployment.
  • Conduct regression and release-readiness testing.
  • Clearly communicate critical defects and potential release risks to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Reporting

  • Maintain organized documentation for:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test results
    • Defects
    • Regression suites
  • Track quality metrics including:
    • Defect density
    • Test coverage
    • Pass/fail rates
    • Production defects
  • Provide stakeholders with clear visibility into product quality and release readiness.

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce and investigate defects.
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Daily standups
    • Retrospectives
    • Release discussions
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams throughout the SDLC.
  • Advocate for quality without unnecessarily slowing down delivery.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Naturally identify edge cases others overlook.
  • Write clear, structured, and repeatable test cases.
  • Are methodical without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Can clearly explain technical issues to developers.
  • Understand when automation adds value and when manual testing is more effective.
  • Take ownership of bugs through validation and resolution.
  • Care about the overall user experience, not simply whether a test passes.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional QA or software testing experience.
  • Strong hands-on manual testing experience.
  • Experience with functional and regression testing.
  • Experience documenting and tracking defects using Jira or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with test management platforms such as:
    • TestRail
    • Zephyr
  • Familiarity with at least one automation framework:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
    • Agile development
    • QA methodologies
    • Defect lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing SaaS or enterprise software products.
  • Strong API testing experience using Postman or RestAssured.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with performance testing using JMeter or Locust.
  • Exposure to security or vulnerability testing.
  • Experience working within compliance-heavy software environments.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern engineering workflows.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing new requirements and writing test cases for an upcoming feature. You’ll execute manual tests, run regression suites, investigate failed automated tests, and document any defects you uncover.

Throughout the day, you’ll work directly with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, test APIs or integrations, and assess whether builds are ready for release.

In short: you find and help resolve problems before customers encounter them.

The Team Lead will serve as the first level of operational and clinical support for nurses, helping to drive productivity, quality, documentation accuracy, adherence, attendance, engagement, and compliance. Job title:

Clinical Operations Supervisor

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee day-to-day performance and workflow execution for a team of telephonic Registered Nurses supporting the Specialty Pharmacy program.

Performance Management and Coaching

  • Support performance improvement plans, corrective action documentation, attendance management, and escalation processes when needed.
  • Recognize strong performance and promote employee engagement, retention, and team morale.
  • Reinforce best practices through team huddles, side-by-side support, refresher coaching, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Clinical Quality, Compliance, and Patient Experience

  • Reinforce adherence to clinical workflows, call handling expectations, documentation standards, escalation requirements, and approved patient education resources.
  • Support accurate completion of clinical assessments, patient education, documentation, and patient/caregiver follow-up in accordance with program requirements.
  • Ensure nurses follow internal processes for adverse event identification, notification, and management within the nursing scope of practice.
  • Support timely escalation of clinical concerns, medication adherence issues, new or unreported symptoms, and other health-related matters identified during the clinical assessment.
  • Partner with Quality, Training, Compliance, and Operations leadership to identify trends, close gaps, and drive improvement.

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

Leadership and People Management

Clinical and Operational Excellence

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The P2P Search team is building a next-gen stack for resilient, decentralized search. We're serious about decentralization -- that means a truly peer-to-peer architecture with no centralized index. It's search without servers -- our technology empowers anyone to spin up a self-organizing, unstoppable search engine for text, pics, chats, locations, or any data you can imagine.

Requirements

We're seeking talented software engineers with a passion for P2P, an interest in research but a bias for building, and a deep understanding of some combination of the following:

  • Kademlia DHT.

  • Distributed indexing and the relevant research literature: skip graphs, prefix hash trees, m-LIGHT, locality sensitive hashing.

  • Distributed databases and CRDTs.

  • Networking for P2P: TCP/IP, transport-layer connection orientation and reliability models, multiplexing, NAT traversal, encryption.

  • Classical IR topics and search engine architecture: recall vs. precision, ranking algorithms, lexical vs. semantic search, inverted indices, etc.

  • Network protocol testing, evaluation, and optimization.

  • Writing high performance, highly concurrent networking code.

  • The Holepunch stack: hyperdht, hyperswarm, hypercore, hyperbee, hyperdrive, udx-native

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

This role is responsible for leading business development strategy, sales execution, and market expansion across two critical growth businesses within FNBO. The role has broad accountability for two distinct business lines, the majority of the role is supporting Home Improvement Lending.

1.Home Improvement Lending (HIL) – Leading a team responsible for acquiring and expanding relationships with contractors, dealers, and organizations that offer FNBO lending solutions to consumers seeking financing for home improvement projects.
2.Card Personalization Solutions – Leading a business development associate responsible for acquiring organizations that require card issuance and personalization services, including gift cards, debit cards, credit cards, and related payment card solutions.

This role develops and executes business growth strategies, establishes long-term client acquisition plans, manages business development resources, and influences outcomes across multiple departments and stakeholders. In addition to leading business development for HIL and Card Personalization, they will also play a leadership role in the overall business development team including the Cobrand and Financial Institution credit card business development space. Data Analysis & Insights
  • Analyze large-scale datasets related to agent performance, support interactions and QA.
  • Write optimized SQL queries using tools like BigQuery and ClickHouse.
  • Build dashboards in Tableau, Metabase.
  • Detect behavioral and performance trends among agents and support teams.
  • Partner with QA to identify root causes in agent behavior and customer issues.

LLM & Prompting
  • Use LLM tools with practical prompt engineering for daily analytical tasks, summarization, and insights generation.
  • Ability to assess and profile LLM outputs for quality, relevance, and analytical correctness in business contexts.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and integrating model outputs into analytical or internal tooling workflows.

  • Suggest and co-build improvements in agent tooling, ticket routing, and SLA tracking.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Act as an analytical partner to Operations, Support Management, QA, and Training.
  • Work with Data Engineering to ensure clean, accurate, and well-modeled data pipelines.

About the Company 

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer. 

Meet The Team:

The Pseudo-Labeling team's goal is to create high-quality annotations on sensor data (images, point clouds). The annotations include 2D, 3D bounding boxes, classes, trajectories, lane lines, segmentations, depths, and high-definition map elements. The annotations are then used by different downstream users — for example, perception teams use them to train various models, mapping teams use them to build and maintain HD maps, and simulation teams use them for generating new data.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, implement, test and deploy offline 3D reconstruction, lane line detection, and automatic mapping/map creation modules to generate high-quality annotations on Cloud Services from logged sensor data (Cameras, Lidars, Radars, GPS/IMU).

  • Develop and improve pose estimation algorithms to support accurate localization, sensor fusion, and 3D scene reconstruction.

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrated competencies and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 3+ years of experience OR;
  • Required Qualifications (some combination of the following skills):
    • Experience in lane line annotation creation or automatic mapping/map creation.
    • Familiarity with the latest lane line detection and creation machine learning models.
    • Familiarity with pose estimation.
    • Active Learning & Pseudo-labeling – Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Model training.

Overview

Nakupuna Federal is seeking a Senior Business/Functional Analyst to join our team of talented consultants providing Contractor Support Services (CSS) to the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC). Support under this contract includes technical services supporting application development efforts to modernize NAVSUP supply and logistics applications and manage associated technical debt. The Senior Business/Functional Analyst will provide functional and business analysis expertise throughout the software development lifecycle and work closely with Government and contractor team members in an Agile delivery environment.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons:

  • Provide functional knowledge and subject matter expertise for assigned applications and perform assigned application support activities.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and maintain business and functional requirements obtained from customers, users, and other stakeholders.
  • Create, update, and maintain work items in the Enterprise Platform, currently AzDO, ensuring activities and supporting information are accurately documented and kept current within five business days.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM to decompose requirements and stories into work that can reasonably be completed within a sprint, generally within 10–15 business days and assist in defining Acceptance Criteria and the sprint Definition of Done.
  • Identify and document the tasks required to successfully complete Product Backlog Items (PBIs) in AzDO.
  • Develop PBI estimates and project roadmaps in support of project requirements, priorities, and schedules.
  • Establish and maintain traceability and dependencies between requirements, including Epics, Features, PBIs, Stories, Tasks, and associated systems, within AzDO.
  • Work closely with the Government to continually maintain the Product Backlog in alignment with the Agile cadence, ensuring necessary Release and Sprint Backlog items are defined with Acceptance Criteria and available for Government prioritization before the start of each release and sprint.
  • Support development priorities in accordance with the Program Backlog.
  • Adhere to Scrum best practices and participate in recommended Scrum Events and Artifacts in accordance with the 2020 Scrum Guide, Agile Kanban practices, or other Agile or Scrum practices approved by the Government PO.
  • Effectively facilitate and participate in Scrum and Agile events and practices.
  • Support the full range of System/Software Development Lifecycle activities, including requirements, analysis, design, development, testing, security, and deployment.
  • Coordinate analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment activities necessary to complete assigned stories in accordance with Acceptance Criteria and the Definition of Done.
  • Propose Minimum Viable Product (MVP) solutions that provide an initial capability to end users while enabling user feedback to influence future development sprints.
  • Develop documentation in accordance with Agile Scrum best practices and the NAVSUP BSC Service Delivery Model.
  • Identify, define, or modify interfaces with other systems and applications and ensure agreements with interfacing systems/applications are formally documented.
  • Analyze system requirements and translate functional designs into detailed logic sufficient to support coding of assigned software systems, modules, and components.
  • Review individual modules and overall system designs for validity, including validation of record input, data elements, and output reports.
  • Perform required testing based on established Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done to verify software and system quality and functionality.
  • Prepare release packages for Government approval.
  • Provide pre-implementation training resources to customers and users.
  • Support the resolution of Production Outages.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM and SM to define and deliver metrics supporting project objectives. Metrics may include release burnup, sprint burndown, planned versus accepted PBI estimates, escaped defects, velocity, and other evolving measures, with a maximum of 10 metrics per team.
  • Provide comprehensive application Transfer of Knowledge to NAVSUP BSC application team personnel through concise, shop-usable lesson plans and other appropriate knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Actively provide daily mentoring to Government team members while performing assigned activities to increase Government personnel knowledge and familiarity with analyst tasks and support independent performance of similar future activities.
  • Support documentation of mentoring and knowledge-transfer activities for inclusion in monthly progress reports.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess strong business and functional analysis capabilities and have experience operating as part of an Agile application development team. Specifically, the candidate should possess the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Demonstrated ability to elicit, document, analyze, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Knowledge and practical experience with Agile concepts, principles, practices, and team-based delivery.
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools and techniques, including SQL and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to analyze data and derive meaningful insights.
  • Ability to identify, analyze, and assist in resolving complex business and functional problems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, users, technical personnel, Government stakeholders, and team members at varying organizational levels.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and completeness in requirements, work items, and supporting documentation.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs, priorities, requirements, and Agile delivery schedules.
  • Ability to establish effective working relationships and collaborate successfully within cross-functional Government and contractor teams.
  • Knowledge of business processes, applicable industry trends, and business analysis best practices.
  • Ability to think strategically and align proposed business and functional solutions with organizational and program goals.
  • Prior DoN or DoW information technology experience is a plus.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to successfully complete the background investigation required for a Public Trust position.

Experience: Minimum of three (3) years of experience with Agile concepts and principles and experience participating as a member of Agile teams. Minimum of five (5) years of experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements.

Education: Minimum of two (2) years of college/work experience, in accordance with contract requirements

Location: Remote position. Minimal travel may be required at the client's request.

Physical Requirements: The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation:

  • Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
  • Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and working on a computer.

About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to client code and backend services. The client code is a mix of C#, XAML, and Go. Prior Go expertise is not a requirement.
  • Bring a special focus on our Windows platform, building and maintaining our Windows client using the modern WinUI/Windows App SDK stack, while contributing to common code that supports macOS, mobile, and other core client platforms.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with engineers on a native Windows desktop client using Windows App SDK, WinUI, C#, XAML and Go
  • Implement support for the latest Windows platform features while maintaining compatibility with a subset of older versions
  • Develop and optimize product features on Windows, with a focus on UI components and platform integration
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests using Microsoft Testing Platform v2 and xUnit
  • Contribute to common, cross-platform Tailscale code

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber is building one of the most technically advanced fiber-first broadband networks in the Pacific Northwest, and we're moving fast. As Vice President of Network Architecture & Engineering, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full network stack — access, voice, subscriber edge, IP core, transport, and infrastructure. You will lead a team of Principal Architects and Directors, own the multi-year technology roadmap, and drive the transformation programs that reduce cost, accelerate deployment, and position Ziply for competitive leadership in every market we enter.

This is an executive role that demands equal command of technical depth and business impact. You will build the business cases, secure the investments, and deliver the results — measured in dollars saved, deployment velocity accelerated, and operational dependencies eliminated.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Network Architecture Strategy & Transformation

·Define and own the multi-year network architecture roadmap across voice, access, subscriber edge, IP core & metro, transport, and infrastructure domains.

·Drive technology transformation programs: legacy platform exits, vendor-agnostic architecture adoption, zero-touch provisioning, and network automation.

Leadership & Organizational Capability

·Lead and scale a team of Principal Architects and Directors; build organizational capability through director- and principal-level hiring and development.

·Represent the technology organization in executive-level discussions, board briefings, and strategic partnership negotiations.

·Set clear objectives, success metrics, and accountability for architecture and engineering leaders; coach teams through complex technical, financial, and organizational tradeoffs.

·Develop succession depth and leadership bench strength for critical architecture and engineering functions.

Business Case, Investment & Financial Planning

·Develop and own business cases for major network investments — quantifying cost savings, stranded asset recovery, and competitive positioning for executive and board approval.

·Deliver measurable cost reductions through optics standardization, technology consolidation (DACS, legacy platforms), and operational independence from TSA and vendor lock-in agreements.

·Collaborate with the Enterprise Delivery Office on CapEx and OpEx planning for all network engineering initiatives.

Technology Certification, Vendor Strategy & Selection

·Establish and operate a technology certification program: device qualification, PoC lab management, vendor-donated equipment programs, and accelerated certification cycles.

·Own vendor and technology selection: RFPs, PoCs, architecture reviews, and contract negotiations across the network stack.

Cross-Functional Operations & Execution

·Partner with Network Planning, Platform Ops, IT/Platform Technology, and NOC to ensure architecture enables operational efficiency and autonomous network operations.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

·15+ years of progressive network engineering and architecture experience, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a broadband ISP, CLEC, or telco.

·Proven track record of delivering large-scale network transformation programs with quantifiable business impact — cost savings, asset recovery, or competitive differentiation measured in the tens to hundreds of millions.

·Experience scaling high-performance architecture or engineering teams; demonstrated ability to add director- and principal-level talent to strengthen organizational capability.

·Hands-on experience with transport (400G/100G), fiber voice/VoIP business cases, and CPE/modem platform migrations at scale.

·Deep familiarity with zero-touch provisioning, vendor-agnostic orchestration, and network automation platforms.

·Experience exiting legacy technology dependencies: TSA agreements, end-of-life platforms (DACS, TDM, legacy ACS), and third-party operational agreements.

·Strong business acumen: ability to build, defend, and deliver on multi-million-dollar investment cases at the executive level.

·Excellent cross-functional leadership: able to align engineering, operations, finance, and vendor partners around shared outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

·Advanced degree such as MS, MBA, or equivalent executive-level business or technical education.

·Experience establishing or operating a technology lab or architecture center (vendor certification, PoC environments, donated equipment programs).

·Background in digital transformation or operations modernization — omni-channel, automation, AI-assisted operations, or field technician tooling.

·Intellectual property, publication, patent, or industry thought-leadership experience in networking, automation, platform modernization, or subscriber experience domains.

·Prior experience at a fiber-first or fiber-overbuilder ISP in a competitive broadband market.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Executive presence with the ability to influence across Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, and executive leadership.

·Strong analytical, financial, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance technical excellence, customer impact, operational risk, and business value.

·Ability to build trust, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Work Authorization
