jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.excerpt: About Gifted Savings Gifted Savings is the first national nonprofit to combine the gifting of real-world investment assets—a diversified $1,000 portfolio of stocks, bonds, Bitcoin, and a CD—with real-world financial education for every participating high school senior.
jobs.description:
About Gifted Savings

Gifted Savings is the first national nonprofit to combine the gifting of real-world investment assets—a diversified $1,000 portfolio of stocks, bonds, Bitcoin, and a CD—with real-world financial education for every participating high school senior. The model is designed to give students both skin in the game and a practical understanding of investing and long-term wealth creation. Through a next-generation web app, students track their portfolio and complete financial literacy lessons tied directly to what they own. When they turn 18 and complete the program, their investment portfolio is transferred to them to use as they choose.

Founded by serial entrepreneur Farhad Mohit — whose ventures, including Flipagram (now TikTok), Shopzilla, and BizRate have generated more than $1 billion in exits — Gifted Savings is powered by a bold philanthropic model in which a committed group of patrons covers all operating expenses. This ensures that 100% of every donor’s gift goes directly to funding student investment accounts and expanding long-term opportunities for graduates nationwide.

Gifted Savings has been featured on the main stage at TEDNext and recognized by the Anthem Awards and Fast Company’s Innovation by Design Awards for its innovative approach to financial education and youth empowerment.

About the role

Gifted Savings, the non-profit start-up that is making it simple, efficient and rewarding to gift real investments and financial literacy to young people at scale, is seeking a strategic, execution-focused Chief Operating Officer (COO) to help grow and strengthen both our national high school program and our emerging direct-giving Friends & Family platform — a new initiative currently in development, designed to expand and simplify investment gifting beyond the classroom.

If you’re a builder and operator who wants your work to have real, lasting impact, this is a rare opportunity to help shape an organization working at the intersection of infectious generosity, financial empowerment, and long-term economic opportunity for young people.

In this role, you will lead the organization’s core business functions — including finance, legal, risk, compliance, operations, and HR — ensuring that Gifted Savings is built on a strong, durable foundation as we grow. You’ll work closely with the Executive Director to translate vision into systems, structure, and execution.

What you'll do

The Chief Operating Officer will own and integrate Gifted Savings’ core operating functions, ensuring the organization scales with clarity, discipline, and alignment across programs, product, and compliance.

This role reports directly to the Executive Director.

Organizational Leadership & Strategy

  • Partner closely with the Executive Director to translate organizational vision into clear operating strategy, priorities, and execution
  • Serve as a key member of the leadership team, helping guide decision-making across programs, partnerships, and growth
  • Anticipate and proactively address operational, financial, and regulatory risks as the organization evolves

Finance & Financial Strategy

  • Own the organization’s financial strategy, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning
  • Oversee financial operations and controls, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and accountability across all programs and funds
  • Manage and support the Finance & Operations Manager (CPA), who leads day-to-day bookkeeping and supports audit execution
  • Ensure strong financial governance and compliance with nonprofit financial requirements
  • Evaluate and structure financial models related to new initiatives, including the Friends & Family platform

Legal, Risk & Compliance

  • Lead all aspects of legal, regulatory, and compliance strategy across both nonprofit and financial services–adjacent activities
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, auditors, and regulatory advisors
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Product and external compliance partners — including the broker-dealer, RIA consultants, and CCO — translating regulatory requirements into clear product guardrails and ensuring alignment in execution across the organization
  • Support the design and implementation of compliant financial infrastructure as Friends & Family moves from early development toward launch and scale

Operations & Infrastructure

  • Build lightweight, effective systems, workflows, and cross-functional processes that support a high-performing, distributed team today and scale over time
  • Oversee vendor management, contracts, and operational partnerships
  • Establish and track key metrics to understand performance, identify risks, and inform decision-making

People & HR

  • Oversee HR operations, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and team development
  • Maintain a strong, values-driven organizational culture
  • Support managers in developing clear roles, goals, and accountability across the team

Qualifications

Who You Are

  • You are a proven leader who works at start-up speed and has an insatiable drive to improve and scale operations.
  • You bring 7+ years of experience in operations, finance, or general management, ideally as a senior leader in an innovative nonprofit, tech startup, fintech, or other fast-moving environment.
  • You are a strong financial leader with expertise in budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and decision-making
  • You have experience navigating legal, compliance, or regulatory environments (fintech, financial services, nonprofit, or adjacent fields)
  • You are a builder-operator who can translate big ideas into clear processes, structures, and execution
  • You are excited by the challenge of building something new at the intersection of social impact, technology, and financial infrastructure
  • You are both strategic and hands-on — equally comfortable setting direction, diving into details, and doing the work yourself
  • You combine rigorous data-driven thinking with a test-and-learn mindset, using hypothesis testing, metrics, and dashboards to move faster, improve performance, and guide better decisions
  • You lead by example in using AI tools and thoughtfully integrate emerging technologies to improve how teams work and make decisions
  • You are an exceptional communicator who can align stakeholders across functions and levels, and translate complex financial, legal, or operational challenges into clear decisions and next steps
  • You are deeply mission-driven and motivated by expanding economic opportunity for young people

Bonus (Not Required)

  • You have experience in both nonprofit and fintech or financial services environments
  • You’ve worked with custodial accounts (UTMA/UGMA), broker-dealer or RIA structures, or financial product design
  • You have experience leading early-stage startups or scaling organizations
  • You have experience working on consumer financial products, giving platforms, or payments systems

Why You Should Join Us

  • Impact: Work on something that will radically advance financial inclusion — and philanthropy — in America and beyond.
  • Amazing Culture: Join a high-performing team whose shared values are: Big Dreams and Bold Action, Results and Learning, Generosity and Teamwork, Honesty and Authenticity, and Freedom and Responsibility.
  • Small Team: Join as an early team member, shaping an idea that can change the world for good.
  • Full Benefits: Get 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents.
  • Bonus Program: Earn our innovative Bitcoin-denominated deferred bonus plan, allowing you to have the amazing upside of being in a startup while working on a truly meaningful mission.
  • Unlimited PTO: We have a flexible time-off (sick and vacation) policy to make sure we’re always taking care of ourselves, so we can help others.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote work environment, with occasional travel to connect with team members and participate in impactful program events.
  • Retirement Plan: Plan for your future with access to a 403(b) plan that’s simple to manage.
  • Growth: Thrive within a growing organization that prioritizes innovation, offering you the chance to shape your career while advancing financial education.

Other Important Information

This is a full-time, remote leadership role based in the United States, with occasional travel for team meetings and program-related events.

Compensation for this role is expected to be in the range of $170,000–$210,000, with final salary determined based on experience, skills, and organizational needs. Gifted Savings reserves the right to modify this range at any time.

We are not considering candidates currently based outside of the United States, and we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

To Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume
  • A brief cover letter (1 page max) explaining why you’re the right person for this role and why you’re excited about Gifted SavingsDescribe the experience and attributes of the ideal candidate.

Northern New England Greenway Manager

About the job

Who we are:

The East Coast Greenway is a nationally connected, locally rooted trail system linking 15 states and more than 450 communities. The nonprofit East Coast Greenway Alliance leads the development of this 3,000-mile route from Maine to Florida. Working from early planning through ribbon cuttings, the Alliance partners with communities to secure funding, share trail-building expertise and connect efforts across city, county and state lines — turning bold visions into completed Greenway miles.

What we offer:

  • 401(k) retirement plan up to 6% employer match.
  • 37.5 hour work week
  • 15 paid vacation days per year (increases to 17 after second year of service)
  • 11 paid holidays & paid sick leave
  • Summer Fresh Air Fridays (office is closed on Fridays in July and August)
  • Staff development fund, active commuting benefit and charitable giving match
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance. ECGA covers 90% of premium for medical and 50% dental & vision for employees & 50% toward dependents’ medical/dental/vision.

About the role:

The Northern New England Greenway Manager is a full-time position that carries multi-state responsibilities for all aspects of greenway development, partnerships, volunteer engagement, and greenway advocacy tasks in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Maine. The Northern New England Manager works under the direction of the National Greenway Director in coordination with other East Coast Greenway Alliance (ECGA) staff.

This position will implement programs that support the ECGA Strategic Plan and specific strategies and goals in the region. The right candidate will grow, support, and empower our volunteers in the state and must be able to travel frequently within the region for meetings, events, and site visits. Work will entail planning, design, relationship building, coalition building, data collection, field investigations, fundraising assistance, and using Geographic information system (GIS) for mapping.

Deadline to apply: Sunday, July 12, 2026.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Complete and monitor East Coast Greenway (ECG) signage throughout the states and update the ECGA online trip planner (map.greenway.org). Work to move a maximum amount of the on-road portions off-road (including designating trail as official ECG) and make remaining on-road sections as safe and bicycle/pedestrian-friendly as feasible.
  • Keep the GIS data-reporting system up-to-date and create reports as requested (at least quarterly).
  • Assist our volunteer State Committees and other volunteers within the state.
  • Build/maintain a strong network of strategic alliances with public agencies, elected officials, and organizations in each state to continue strong Greenway progress. Keep contacts updated in organization CRM.
  • Communicate state information in coordination with other staff for the ECGA website, newsletters, and social media. Engage local media with support from the ECGA communications team.
  • Provide timely information to assist with overall fundraising efforts in the region.

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively and tactfully with a wide range of people and personalities to establish collaborative partnerships as a team player.
  • Entrepreneurial and strategic approach; tenaciously takes initiative and applies sound judgment.
  • Able to function in a fast-paced work environment; able to work on several project deadlines simultaneously, delivering professional work on-time and on-budget.
  • Well-organized, self-motivated and independent worker: understands the need to develop work plans and to prioritize work efficiently. Takes record-keeping, documentation and file management seriously.
  • Self-starter. Ability to work independently and set strategy for the region.
  • Able to travel throughout the region for meetings and events.
  • Demonstrated leadership in implementing greenway projects that promote transportation equity.
  • Track record engaging and motivating volunteers.
  • Three years or more project management and/or program experience in a relevant area such as greenway development, environmental policy, public health, or community organizing.
  • Education and work experience: Bachelor's degree in urban and regional planning, transportation planning, civil engineering, landscape architecture and/or combination of relevant post graduate degree and/or professional experience.
  • Nonprofit experience is preferred.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Familiarity with GIS mapping software and willingness to learn. Experience with GIS mapping is preferred. The alliance utilizes QGIS for mapping and data management; maintaining the route map in QGIS for the region is a requirement of the role.
  • Strong computer skills: Proficient in Google platforms. Can easily create Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.
  • Passionate commitment to ECGA mission.
  • Strong sense of personal responsibility and integrity.
  • Positive, can-do attitude.

Further Detail:

  1. Planning
  1. Develop detailed progress reports on the ECG in the region in collaboration with State Committee leaders, partner agencies, and organizations.
  2. Work with ECGA staff and State Committees to plan logistics for ECG progress in the region, identifying, and finding solutions for key gaps and opportunities.
  1. Greenway Implementation
  1. Become familiar in detail with the route throughout the regional corridor.
  2. Advocate for the funding necessary to plan, design, and build the Greenway.
  3. Work directly with State Committees and agency and non-profit partners to advance implementation of ECG plans. Network, engage, and educate local to federal stakeholders.
  4. Manage the trail designation process within the region.
  5. Coordinate signage program within the state including:
  6. Work with state DOTs, local municipalities, parks, and volunteers to implement full signage of the current East Coast Greenway travel route throughout the region.
  7. Build and maintain collaborative partnerships with other bike/ped organizations, community groups, public and private agencies, and trail advocates to further Greenway priorities.
  8. Organize ECGA state meetings, workshops, and training sessions.
  9. Serve as point of contact for trail managers/developers/advocates regarding ECG questions. Help provide assistance or direct inquiries to appropriate sources.
  10. Monitor designated trail segments to ensure they continue to meet our standards.
  11. Get ECG included in state and local plans, official reports, and on official maps.
  12. Organize state and regional advocacy to secure trail development funding.
  1. Building Public Support
  1. Build and support strong volunteer engagement including organizing State’s Committee meetings.
  2. Organize and participate in events throughout the state throughout the year: including bike rides, walks, advocacy days, and community events.
  1. Tracking Progress
  1. Present reports on ECGA progress for the region internally and externally.
  2. Maintain GIS database for all current and envisioned routing in each state.
  1. Communications
  1. Media
    1. Working in coordination with the ECGA communications team, respond to or help direct to the most appropriate party inquiries by the public, our partners, and media related to the ECG.
    2. Provide state and regional news & stories for e-news, website, & social media.
  1. Promotion
  1. Represent ECGA at relevant meetings and events.
  1. Administrative
  1. Maintain files, a database of contacts, and email groups as needed for your communication within the region.
  1. Fundraising
  1. Assist the development team as directed to increase regional resources from ECGA membership, donors, foundations, corporate support, and successful events.
  1. Assist with other tasks as assigned.

Salary and Benefits:

This is a full-time position with salary commensurate with experience. Hiring range: $68,000-80,000. This is a remote position based along the route in Maine, New Hampshire or Massachusetts. The manager must have reliable access to transportation to be able to regularly and efficiently travel throughout the region for meetings and events. Deadline to apply: Sunday, July 12th.

  • 401(k) retirement plan up to 6% employer match
  • 37.5 hour work week
  • 15 paid vacation days per year (increases to 17 after second year of service)
  • 11 paid holidays & paid sick leave
  • Summer Fresh Air Fridays (office is closed on Fridays in July and August)
  • Staff development fund, active commuting benefit and charitable giving match
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance. ECGA covers 90% of premium for medical and 50% dental & vision for employees & 50% toward dependents’ medical/dental/vision.

ECGA is an equal opportunity employer and seeks qualified candidates regardless of race, color, creed, age, veteran status, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, or national origin. We are committed to achieving an inclusive, diverse workplace that values every individual.

ABOUT THIS POSITION

The CDI Product Consultants at Waystar joins a seasoned Clinical team that plays an active role in implementation & delivery of the CDI product for our clients. This role interacts with client end users and managers to ensure adoption of best practices workflows while working cross-functionally with the larger Customer Success teams for successful implementation and adoption for our clients. The Consultants also ensure the complexity of our AI technology is married with the clinical perspective and needs of our clients through data analysis, auditing and providing clinical insight into the product development.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

●Transfer knowledge of our CDI Suite of products and workflows to new and client users

● Provide client support to drive adoption of the Aware CDI product suite

● Utilize best practice processes for successful client adoption

● Actively manage the client experience to deliver on implementation milestones, manage client support requests and expectations, monitor client adoption of the CDI Suite

● Monitor client key performance indicators to identify opportunities for process improvement for clients

●Collaborate with the larger Waystar Customer Success team to create a seamless, integrated, and consistent experience for clients and users

● Collaborate with Waystar’s Education team as a clinical subject matter expert for content and delivery of educational programs that support best practices in the industry and with our products

● Collaborate with product teams as a subject matter expert to define and design the clinical elements that drive our product suite

● Provide insights from client interactions to inform future research initiatives and drive product roadmaps

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

● Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Nursing (RN) required

● A minimum of 5-7 years of experience in CDI role with demonstrated progressive growth in roles and responsibilities in CDI leadership

● Experience with multiple clinical documentation programs, medical record coding, healthcare billing and revenue cycle management

● Demonstrated presentation skills with various stakeholders ranging from internal partners to C-suite

● Experience presenting CDI content and information

● 5+ years of clinical experience in acute care environments, critical care or ED preferred

● Self-starter, who is extremely motivated to demonstrate success

● Innovator who is looking for unique solutions that solve complex problems

● Attention to detail, highly organized, with an absolute focus on quality of work

● Team player DNA with a desire to solve for the interests of our clients and of our business

● Ability to travel 25 - 50% to client sites and company headquarters Preferred Requirements:

● Master’s degree in healthcare related field

Through a smart platform and better experience, Waystar helps providers simplify healthcare payments and yield powerful results throughout the complete revenue cycle.

Waystar’s healthcare payments platform combines innovative, cloud-based technology, robust data, and unparalleled client support to streamline workflows and improve financials so providers can focus on what matters most: their patients and communities. Waystar products have won multiple Best in KLAS® or Category Leader awards since 2010 and earned multiple #1 rankings from Black Book™ surveys since 2012. The Waystar platform supports more than 500,000 providers, 1,000 health systems and hospitals, and 5,000 payers and health plans. For more information, visit waystar.comor follow @Waystaron Twitter.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:

The Vice President, Product Strategy & Management is responsible for setting the strategic direction and driving the performance of Lexia’s student instruction, professional learning, and educator insights product portfolio. This role owns product‑level strategy, integrated product roadmaps, lifecycle management, and product outcomes, ensuring products deliver meaningful impact for students and educators while supporting business goals.

Reporting to the SVP, Product, the VP leads a high‑performing product management and technical product management organization and works closely with cross‑functional partners across Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Customer Success. This VP will harness their deep K–12 knowledge to translate classroom realities into innovative product strategies that accelerate literacy outcomes and improve educator effectiveness.

Serving as a critical bridge between strategy and execution, this leader ensures product investments are focused, data‑informed, and aligned to Lexia’s mission of Literacy for All.

Job Responsibilities:

Portfolio Strategy & Performance

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management of all product lines within the portfolio, aligned to business goals.
  • Translate product vision into cohesive, integrated roadmaps, and clear product strategies.
  • Lead data‑informed decision‑making for product lifecycle transitions, investment focus, and support plans.
  • Work with Product Operations to define, track, and communicate key product performance metrics (adoption, engagement, financial contribution) to executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with SVP, Product to drive strong product contributions across product lines, including collaborating on forecasting, and investment scenario planning.

Strategic Roadmap Ownership & Execution

  • Collaborate with Product Operations to forecast, track, and report portfolio budgets; document and report variance analysis, and product margin reviews.
  • Lead the Product Management teams in translating Lexia’s vision of Literacy for All and the broader product strategy into actionable, integrated roadmaps across Professional Learning, Student Instruction and Educator Insights.
  • Ensure roadmaps are aligned to market needs and strategic business objectives, appropriately resourced to match strategic investment levels, and designed to deliver measurable incremental value.
  • Develop and maintain frameworks for product‑market fit, competitive differentiation, and market positioning.
  • Identify and implement scalable, AI-based tools for updating, maintaining, and communicating roadmaps across the portfolio.
  • Lead repeatable processes for portfolio planning, communicating roadmap updates, and go‑to‑market product readiness.

Market Insights & Alignment

  • Coordinate market analysis, customer research, and competitive intelligence efforts to identify and scope critical investment opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Research to ensure roadmaps reflect the needs of districts, states, teachers, and students.
  • Establish structured, repeatable cross‑functional processes for integrating customer feedback, GTM insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends into planning.

Product Development & Lifecycle Leadership

  • Drive strong product management practices, ensuring requirements are clear and documented, user stories are well defined, and outcomes are measurable.
  • Partner with Education & Research, Design, and Engineering with a problem‑solving mindset to deliver high‑quality K-12 curriculum and digital products grounded in sound pedagogy.
  • Align collaborative processes across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure cohesive development and delivery.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales, and Operations to align product timelines with resource plans, revenue goals, and district and state adoption cycles.
  • Serve as a bridge between strategy and execution across content, technology, and delivery.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and mentor high‑performing product management and technical product management teams that leverage the latest systems and tools to plan and iterate with speed at scale.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, customer‑centricity, innovation, and continuous improvement aligned to Lexia’s strategic objectives.
  • Identify and equip team members with the frameworks, AI-based tools, and skills training needed to deliver consistently and effectively.

Executive & External Engagement

  • Represent the product portfolio in executive forums, providing insights and recommendations to inform strategic decision‑making.
  • Participate in high‑stakes customer engagements, as appropriate, to inform product direction and strengthen relationships.
  • Model best practices in innovative thinking across the portfolio, establishing shared tools, frameworks, and templates to drive consistency and focus.

Job Requirements:

  • Minimum 8–10 years of product leadership experience in edtech or adjacent space, including 3+ years leading multi-product teams
  • Proven track record of owning product roadmaps and delivering impact in large‑scale product portfolios.
  • Deep, up-to-date expertise in the K-12 landscape, including a comprehensive understanding of Request for Proposals (RFPs), state purchasing processes, and K-12 decision-making cycles; and a strong background in K–12 EdTech or adjacent mission-driven industries.
  • Demonstrated success with SaaS or technology‑enabled education products, driving adoption, retention, and revenue growth.
  • Experience leading within cross‑functional product teams or matrixed organizations to deliver complex digital curriculum products at scale.
  • Exceptional organizational and operational skills, balancing long‑term strategy with near‑term execution.
  • Executive presence with the ability to influence and collaborate at all levels of the organization.

Preferred Experience:

  • 10+ years of leadership experience and/or VP-level leadership

To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .

Remote First Work Environment

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.

If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.

If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance.

As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history).

We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.

jobs.excerpt: About WoltAt Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world.
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We’re looking for an experienced Analytics Manager to join Wolt in Berlin, Stockholm, Helsinki, or London!

About the Marketing Analytics team

In the Marketing Analytics team, we are focused on improving the effectiveness of our marketing spend and boosting Wolt’s growth. We work across a broad set of marketing questions, helping teams understand what is working, where to invest, and how to improve marketing performance across Wolt. We partner with Marketing, Product, and Strategy & Operations teams closely to guide measurement and tactical decision-making using advanced analytics. Considering the scale of Wolt’s marketing function, there are many exciting problems to be solved and plenty of opportunities to make a business impact!

You’ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals. As we grow the next level of maturity in Marketing Analytics, you’ll help shape the roadmap, develop the team, and build the operating rhythm that turns analysis into better business decisions.

What you’ll be doing

As an Analytics Manager at Wolt, you are essential in revolutionizing our marketing strategies. You’ll define the analytics roadmap for the team, prioritize the most important business questions, and ensure the work leads to clear decisions and follow-through. Acting as a critical partner to senior business and product leaders, this role will drive the Marketing domain forward, shaping the future of our initiatives.

Key responsibilities include defining and monitoring key performance indicators to gauge the effectiveness of innovative marketing initiatives. The role offers an exciting opportunity to brainstorm 0-to-1 growth investment opportunities and establish the foundation for our marketing investment framework. You’ll lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Scientists, helping them stay close to the business and deliver work that improves marketing decisions and outcomes.

Success in this role requires exceptional leadership and project management skills, along with strong communication and interpersonal abilities. Collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams will be crucial in fostering a culture of shared success and innovation. This position offers a thrilling opportunity to shape the future of growth at Wolt!

Our humble expectations

  • 6+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position, with 2+ years of leadership experience.
  • Experience in leading large teams (5-10 direct reports)
  • Prior experience in hiring and mentoring skilled members for your data science teams.
  • Expertise with SQL and statistical analysis using Python, R, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of experimentation, attribution, media mix modeling, and marketing measurement concepts, with a pragmatic approach to applying them to business decisions.
  • Clear communication and strong business partnership skills, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions, actions, and measurable impact.

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics!
  • You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, London, Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: hybrid, at the office, or remote within Germany, the UK, Finland or Sweden. 💙
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

3. Delivery Efficiency & Modernization (The AI Mandate)

  • Process Optimization: Establish and monitor core engineering metrics (such as DORA or SPACE frameworks) to identify and eliminate development bottlenecks.

Key Success Outcomes

  • Pragmatic Technical Thinker: You possess a deep understanding of modern cloud architecture and distributed systems. You know how to make smart architectural trade-offs that support business growth.
  • Metrics-Driven Operator: You don't guess; you measure. You are deeply familiar with DORA metrics and engineering productivity frameworks.
  • Forward-Looking Innovator: You stay ahead of the curve. You have a practical, realistic understanding of how AI tools can be safely and effectively leveraged to improve engineering workflows.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

About Uplift

Uplift is a dynamic agency specializing in global talent search, covering EMEA, LATAM, USA, and APAC. With successful placements in 60 countries, we combine speed and cutting-edge technology to source top executive and mid-senior talent across various functions. Our innovative approach integrates global networks, AI, and advanced recruitment tools. Beyond recruitment, we engage with our audience through our podcast, newsletter, and webinars, ensuring we stay at the forefront of talent acquisition and global HR trends.

Job Description

Our client is a global leader in AI-driven industrial reliability, helping asset-heavy industries prevent unplanned downtime through advanced diagnostics, predictive maintenance, and actionable insights. Their platform combines industrial expertise, sensor data, and machine learning at scale to deliver measurable ROI for manufacturers worldwide. AI is central to their product strategy and long-term advantage.

Role Overview (Fully remote USA)

We are hiring a hands-on, senior Director of Product Management, based in the US, to lead our product strategy across asset reliability, process intelligence, and the PlantOS platform. You will set the multi-year roadmap that moves customers from predictive maintenance to prescriptive and semi-autonomous operations, and you will hire and grow the PM team that delivers it.

This is a senior role. You are expected to write specs, run discovery with customers in cement plants and steel mills, hold the prioritization line with engineering, and represent the product credibly at the executive level.

What you'll own

  • Product vision & roadmap. A multi-year vision for PlantOS spanning predictive maintenance, prescriptive decision support, process optimization, and the underlying data platform — translated into a concrete, sequenced roadmap.
  • Backlog and execution. A well-prioritized backlog for a sizable, distributed engineering organization. You can hold the line on what ships next without slowing teams down.
  • Team leadership. Coaching a team of more junior product managers across reliability, process, and platform. You set the bar on discovery, prioritization, and outcome metrics.
  • Customer and partner-facing product leadership. Enterprise accounts in North America and Europe, plus strategic partners (OEMs, CMMS/EAM, GSIs, hyperscalers) and pre-sales.
  • Cross-functional alignment. Tight partnership with Engineering, AI/ML, Platform, and Customer Success on architecture, delivery cadence, and security & compliance.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years in B2B product management, including at least 5 years building enterprise platforms for heavy industry — cement, steel, oil & gas, mining, power, or chemicals.
  • Deep domain knowledge of equipment reliability and maintenance practices (RCM, PdM, CBM) and the plant systems they integrate with: CMMS/EAM (SAP PM, Maximo), historians, DCS, PLC, SCADA, MES.
  • Track record of shipping B2B platform products that engineering teams genuinely want to work on. You manage a backlog as fluently as you write a PRD.
  • Demonstrated PM leadership. You have hired, coached, and leveled-up a team of product managers — not just managed projects.
  • Hands-on instinct. You would rather jump on a customer call or pair with an engineer than send a status email. Senior, but not removed from the work.
  • Executive presence. Comfortable in front of customer C-suite, our executive team, and the board.

Preferred

  • Prior PM leadership at industrial software companies or industrial AI / reliability startups.
  • Exposure to closed-loop automation, advanced process control (APC/MPC), edge AI, or IIoT platforms.
  • Engineering or applied-science background; MBA a plus, not required.

Location

US-based (East or Central time zone preferred). Regular travel to customer sites and to our India engineering hub.

Software Engineer – Go/Golang Backend | Cybersecurity Platform

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Software Engineer specializing in backend development to help build and scale the infrastructure powering a modern cybersecurity platform.

This is not a basic CRUD development role. You’ll work on technically challenging systems involving:

  • Go/Golang backend services
  • High-volume security data processing
  • Distributed and event-driven systems
  • 100+ third-party integrations
  • Scalable APIs and data pipelines
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Multi-tenant data architecture

If you enjoy solving complex backend, infrastructure, and integration problems at scale, this role offers strong technical ownership and impact.

What You’ll Own

Backend Engineering – Go & APIs

  • Build and maintain backend services primarily using Go (Golang).
  • Design scalable REST APIs and internal microservices.
  • Implement authentication, rate limiting, retry mechanisms, fault tolerance, and robust error handling.
  • Write maintainable, production-ready code designed for reliability and scale.
  • Diagnose performance bottlenecks and improve backend efficiency.

Enterprise Integrations

  • Build and maintain integrations across 100+ enterprise systems.
  • Work extensively with REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and external services.
  • Design integrations that remain reliable as data volume and customer usage scale.
  • Troubleshoot integration failures and improve resilience.
  • Implement monitoring and observability around integration health.

Event-Driven Systems & Data Pipelines

  • Design event-driven architectures for processing security data.
  • Build pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment.
  • Work with asynchronous processing, messaging systems, and distributed workflows.
  • Ensure high-volume data can be processed reliably and efficiently.

PostgreSQL & Data Architecture

  • Design scalable data models for multi-tenant applications.
  • Work extensively with PostgreSQL.
  • Design schemas and optimize complex queries.
  • Improve indexing and database performance.
  • Support both operational and analytics-oriented data requirements.
  • Maintain data integrity as the platform scales.

Cloud Infrastructure & Observability

  • Deploy and operate services across cloud environments, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred.
  • Work with scalable compute, managed storage, and messaging infrastructure.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and observability.
  • Diagnose production issues and improve system reliability.
  • Contribute to infrastructure and platform scalability initiatives.

Architecture & Platform Development

  • Collaborate with Product, Security, and Engineering teams.
  • Participate in architecture decisions and technical design reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to AI-powered security workflows and automation initiatives.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong professional backend software engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in Go/Golang, or strong experience with Python, Java, or TypeScript with willingness to transition to Go.
  • Experience building production APIs and distributed backend systems.
  • Strong relational database experience, ideally PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • GCP
    • AWS
    • Azure
  • Hands-on understanding of:
    • REST APIs
    • Webhooks
    • Authentication systems
    • Asynchronous processing
    • Database design and optimization
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to independently own technical problems through resolution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

  • OAuth
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Message queues and asynchronous systems
  • Distributed systems
  • High-volume data pipelines
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Identity and access management
  • Endpoint security platforms
  • Startup or high-growth engineering environments
  • AI/LLM-powered applications and workflows

Core Technology Stack

Backend: Go / Golang
Database: PostgreSQL
APIs: REST, OAuth, Webhooks
Cloud: GCP preferred; AWS/Azure relevant
Architecture: Microservices, distributed systems, event-driven processing
Infrastructure: Messaging systems, monitoring, logging, observability

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’re likely to succeed if you:

  • Prefer backend and systems engineering over frontend/UI development.
  • Have built production systems designed for scale.
  • Understand that integrations need to handle failures, retries, rate limits, and changing external APIs.
  • Care about clean architecture and long-term maintainability.
  • Think deeply about reliability, performance, and observability.
  • Can troubleshoot complex production issues systematically.
  • Take ownership without requiring constant direction.
  • Enjoy fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may spend your day:

  • Building and shipping backend services in Go.
  • Designing an integration with an external enterprise platform.
  • Debugging a production integration or data-processing issue.
  • Optimizing PostgreSQL queries and indexes.
  • Improving API reliability and performance.
  • Building or refining event-driven data pipelines.
  • Reviewing architecture decisions with other engineers.
  • Improving monitoring and observability.
  • Supporting AI-powered security and automation workflows.

In short: you’ll build the scalable backend infrastructure, integrations, and data systems that power a modern cybersecurity platform.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Backend reliability and uptime.
  • API latency and performance.
  • Scalability under increasing workloads.
  • Reliable processing of high-volume security data.
  • Reduced third-party integration failures.
  • Database and query performance.
  • Platform stability and maintainability.
  • Quality and speed of engineering execution.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Work on real distributed backend systems, not basic application development.
  • Solve challenging integration problems across 100+ enterprise systems.
  • Build infrastructure supporting high-volume cybersecurity data.
  • Work across APIs, databases, event-driven architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Exposure to AI-powered security workflows.
  • Strong technical ownership in a fully remote environment.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Backend Engineer
    • Senior Go Engineer
    • Platform Engineer
    • Systems Architect
    • Infrastructure Lead

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Technical Interview
  3. Practical Backend/API Assessment
  4. Cross-Functional Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re a backend engineer who enjoys Go/Golang, distributed systems, PostgreSQL, APIs, integrations, and scalable infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a technically challenging environment where you can build backend systems that process security data at scale and directly influence the architecture and reliability of a growing cybersecurity platform.

Наш процес наймупрозорий та швидкий:

  • Скрінінг резюме (Ми уважно розглядаємо всі резюме, але зв’яжемося лише з релевантними кандидатами)

jobs.description:
Toloka AI supports frontier model post-training by building domain-specific reinforcement learning environments, tasks, and evaluation frameworks designed by real practitioners.

Mindrift, powered by Toloka — a leading enterprise AI and machine learning data partner since 2014 — connects top domain experts with cutting-edge AI initiatives. Backed by Toloka’s deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Eligible firms: McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain & Company, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte (Deloitte S&C), EY-Parthenon, Kearney, and Strategy& (PwC).

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.
  • Design structured consulting tasks for AI agents — break projects into discrete tasks that mirror real consulting work: market sizing, commercial due diligence, cost optimization, growth strategy, operational diagnosis, benchmarking, and more.
  • Define evaluation criteria and quality standards — develop grading frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and golden-answer solutions for each task, used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale.

This is a remote, project-based, individual-contributor role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

Skills & Requirements

  • 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte, EY-Parthenon, Kearney, or Strategy&
  • Strong structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking
  • Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps and deliverables
  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Accountant
jobs.excerpt: About Calibrant Energy Calibrant is a leading provider of on-site energy solutions.
jobs.description:
About Calibrant Energy

Calibrant is a leading provider of on-site energy solutions. Calibrant develops, owns, and operates large-scale solar, battery storage, and microgrids on behalf of our customers — empowering North America's largest power users to achieve their energy goals faster, more economically, and more sustainably.

By combining innovative financing with deep industry expertise, we solve complex energy challenges for large organizations. Our performance-based, no-capex contracts ensure we only get paid when we deliver results — enabling organizations to share in cost savings without any upfront investment.

Position Overview

The Staff Accountant is a core member of Calibrant's accounting team, responsible for the accurate and timely execution of day-to-day accounting operations: journal entries, balance sheet and bank reconciliations, accounts payable, and customer invoicing support. This role is central to delivering a clean, on-time monthly close, and works directly with our external auditors on the schedules and workpapers that support it.

You will work in a multi-entity NetSuite OneWorld environment with an automated AP workflow, on a team that is actively modernizing how the function operates. Calibrant is an AI-forward company: we expect our accountants to use modern automation and AI tooling to eliminate manual effort, and we invest in the systems that make that possible. This is a hands-on, high-visibility seat with a defined path forward for people who perform.

We are looking for someone precise, organized, and genuinely curious — a person who not only clears their assigned reconciliations but asks why the difference was there in the first place.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

Month-End Close & Reconciliations

  • Prepare assigned journal entries for the monthly close, ensuring correct account, subsidiary, and period coding within the established chart of accounts.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations for assigned accounts, with clear documentation of every reconciling item and a plan to clear it.
  • Perform bank reconciliations across multiple operating, project, and restricted-cash accounts.
  • Prepare recurring accruals, prepaid amortization, and fixed asset and depreciation schedules for assigned entities.
  • Research and clear assigned close exceptions before the close deadline, escalating anything unresolved rather than letting it roll forward.
  • Prepare intercompany entries and support the reconciliation of intercompany balances across entities.

Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

  • Process vendor invoices through the automated AP workflow, confirming accurate coding to account, entity, and project, and routing for approval under the established approval matrix.
  • Review invoices for mathematical accuracy, contract or purchase-order agreement, and confirmation that goods or services were received.
  • Set up and maintain vendor master records, including collection of W-9 and banking documentation, with appropriate verification controls.
  • Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies, short-pays, and aged items.
  • Prepare accounts payable aging reports and recommend payment runs based on due dates, discount terms, and cash availability.
  • Serve as a responsive first point of contact for vendor inquiries, maintaining strong working relationships and resolving issues promptly.
  • Process and audit employee expense reports for policy compliance and correct coding.

Customer Invoicing & Collections Support

  • Coordinate with the Asset Management team to produce accurate and timely customer invoices.
  • Verify invoice supporting documentation against contract terms and reconcile billed amounts to the general ledger.
  • Maintain the accounts receivable aging, apply cash receipts, and support collections follow-up on past-due balances.

Audit, Compliance & Reporting Support

  • Prepare schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation requested by external and internal auditors, and respond to follow-up questions on your own workpapers.
  • Compile the data extracts and account-level schedules that feed management reporting, budgeting, and lender or sponsor reporting packages prepared by others on the team.
  • Support sales, use, and indirect tax filings and other recurring compliance deliverables as assigned.
  • Maintain organized, referenced, and reviewable documentation for every entry and reconciliation you prepare.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Work day-to-day in NetSuite and the AP automation platform, and flag data or workflow issues rather than working around them.
  • Partner with the VP of Accounting and senior team members to document and improve recurring processes, and to reduce manual effort in the monthly cycle.
  • Contribute to reconciliation and close-automation initiatives as the team's systems footprint matures.

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of accounting experience, in public accounting or industry.
  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP and standard accounting practice, including accruals, prepaids, and fixed assets.
  • Hands-on experience with an accounting system (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks, or comparable) and strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables.
  • Demonstrable attention to detail. In this role, an entry coded to the wrong entity is a real problem, and we will ask you how you prevent it.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to hold multiple deadlines inside a close calendar.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication with internal teams, vendors, and auditors.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with the judgment to ask rather than assume.
  • Authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Calibrant Energy does not provide visa sponsorship for this role, now or in the future.

Preferred

  • CPA licensed, or actively sitting for the exam. We provide exam fee, materials, and study time support.
  • Experience in energy, renewables, infrastructure, construction, or another growth-stage or project-based business.
  • Multi-entity or multi-currency experience, including intercompany transactions.
  • Exposure to an AP automation platform (Medius, Coupa, Bill.com, or similar) or a reconciliation tool such as BlackLine.
  • NetSuite OneWorld experience specifically.

What Success Looks Like

We are explicit about expectations. In your first year, we expect to be able to say the following:

  • First 30 days — you are processing AP independently with accurate coding, and your first close cycle is complete with support.
  • By 90 days — you own your assigned reconciliations and close entries end to end, delivered on the close calendar without reminders.
  • By six months — you are a reliable first preparer across close, AP, and audit support, your workpapers pass review with minimal comment, and you are identifying process fixes rather than only executing steps. Strong performers here move up; we will talk about that path directly with you.

Classification: Exempt

Status: Full-Time

Benefits

Benefits

We believe in fostering an inclusive environment in which employees feel encouraged to share their unique perspectives, leverage their strengths, and act authentically.

At Calibrant Energy, our priority is to ensure that every team member feels valued and supported. We believe putting wellness first supports a full, holistic, and happier life. We support that by offering benefits that cover you and your family such as: medical, dental, vision insurances, paid time off, paid personal time, paid holidays, paid birthday, paid sick time, company paid short term disability and long term disability, company paid life insurance, 401k with a company match, and more.

Calibrant Energy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions, breastfeeding or reproductive health decisions), gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, personal appearance, genetic information, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, military or veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable U.S. law. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request to: .

jobs.description:
Kyivstar.Tech шукає Product Designer у проєкт TutTam.

TutTam — це FoodTech сервіс-маркетплейс, де заклади можуть реалізувати надлишки продукції, а користувачі — придбати якісну їжу чи послуги зі значними знижками.

Ми шукаємо Product Designer, який(а) допоможе створювати простий та зручний користувацький досвід, проєктувати нові функції продукту та покращувати ключові продуктові метрики разом із продуктовою, аналітичною та технічною командами.

Про нас

Kyivstar.Tech – українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв'язку.

Наша місія – змінювати життя в Україні та у світі, створюючи технологічні рішення і продукти, що реалізують потенціал компаній і потреби користувачів.

Понад 600 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та вебрішення, а також проєктування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.

Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен з нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове.

Що ти будеш робити

  • Проєктувати UX/UI для мобільного застосунку та вебпродукті в TutTam.
  • Брати участь у всьому життєвому циклі функцій: від дослідження проблеми до запуску в продакшн.
  • Проводити User Research, аналізувати поведінку користувачів та формувати дизайн-рішення на основі даних.
  • Створювати User Flows, Wireframes, Mockups та інтерактивні прототипи.
  • Проєктувати нові сценарії користувацького досвіду та покращувати існуючі.
  • Працювати разом із Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Analyst та Engineering-командою над пошуком найкращих продуктових рішень.
  • Проводити usability-тестування та валідувати дизайн-рішення.
  • Розвивати та підтримувати дизайн-систему продукту.
  • Готувати макети до розробки та супроводжувати їх реалізацію.
  • Брати участь у формуванні та перевірці продуктових гіпотез.

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

  • 3+ роки досвіду роботи Product Designer або UX/UI Designer у digital-продуктах.
  • Досвід проєктування мобільних застосунків.
  • Досвід роботи з вебпродуктами.
  • Досвід роботи у продуктових командах.
  • Впевнене володіння Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variables, Design System, Prototyping).
  • Досвід створення дизайн-систем та підтримки їх розвитку.
  • Розуміння принципів User-Centered Design.
  • Досвід проведення User Research, usability testing або Customer Interviews.
  • Розуміння продуктових метрик та впливу дизайну на Activation, Conversion, Retention.
  • Вміння аргументувати дизайн-рішення даними та результатами досліджень.
  • Досвід взаємодії з розробниками та контролю якості реалізації дизайну.

Буде плюсом

  • Досвід роботи у FoodTech, eCommerce, маркетплейсах або HoReCa.
  • Досвід проєктування двосторонніх платформ (Marketplace).
  • Досвід роботи зі складними користувацькими сценаріями.
  • Досвід проведення A/B тестів спільно з продуктовою командою.
  • Базове розуміння HTML/CSS та можливостей сучасних вебтехнологій.
  • Досвід роботи зі стартапами або швидкозростаючими продуктами.
  • Навички створення мікроанімацій або motion-дизайну.
  • Наявність сильного портфоліо реалізованих продуктів.

Що ми пропонуємо

  • Офіс або ремоут – вирішувати тобі.
  • Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі)
  • Навчаємо працівників: є безліч внутрішніх ресурсів і програм від партнерів, власна бібліотека

jobs.title: Creative Director (Marketing)
jobs.excerpt: Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paperWant to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world?
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We’re scaling our business across the UK, US, Australia and Canada, with our amazing team spread across these markets. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

We’re looking for a Creative Director to lead our Marketing Design team (the people behind our limited editions, brand campaigns, social, lifecycle and promotions). You’ll set the creative bar across two quite different worlds: the big, ambitious brand storytelling that makes people fall for us, and the fast creative work, informed by data, that keeps our growth engine humming. You’ll lead two senior designer/art directors directly, and a wider team of makers day to day, coaching them to do the best work of their careers while keeping plenty of moving parts on track. Expect to spend around 70% of your time on creative direction and 30% hands-on, stepping into the work yourself during big campaign moments.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in:

  • Led a limited edition from concept through packaging development to full campaign rollout
  • Steered the social team toward content that’s culturally sharp, fun and unmistakably on-brand
  • Pushed the lifecycle team to create emails people actually want to open
  • Overseen a high-growth promotion from creative concept to launch
  • Coached your two senior designer/art directors through a tricky brief or a bit of creative friction

Let’s talk about you

You’ve led both sides of the coin

You’ve genuinely led both brand storytelling and growth-led creative. Or, you’ve led one and have real curiosity about the other. You know these two worlds need different thinking, different pace and different leadership, and you can flex between them without losing the plot.

You’re organised, not just talented

Big ideas are the baseline here, but so is a genuinely high level of self-motivation, proactivity and organisation. If you thrive only with a lot of structure built around you, this probably isn’t your role, but if you can bring your own structure to ambiguity, you’ll do well.

You’re a self-starter with real creative ambition

You’re fast-paced, comfortable with a bit of chaos and you have the energy to see your ideas through to the finish line (and to bring your team along with you while you do it).

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence, us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

WRS Health is seeking a strategic and results-driven Strategic Sales Executive to drive growth by helping healthcare organizations transform their clinical, operational, and financial performance through innovative software and AI-powered solutions.

This is a Strategic Sales Executive role focused on complex consultative engagements with physician groups, specialty practices, practice management organizations, and healthcare executives.   • Support technical discussions involving APIs, FHIR integrations, cloud architecture, and third-party healthcare systems when appropriate.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of healthcare industry trends, regulatory requirements, reimbursement models, and emerging AI technologies.

Customer Partnership & Market Development

  • Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the evaluation, purchasing, and transition process.
  • Identify opportunities for long-term account expansion, cross-sell, and strategic partnerships.
  • Gather market intelligence and customer feedback to influence product strategy, messaging, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Represent WRS Health at industry conferences, webinars, executive briefings, and customer events.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Leadership teams to strengthen market positioning and accelerate growth initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of successful consultative B2B software sales experience, preferably in enterprise SaaS or healthcare technology.
  • Proven experience selling EHR/EMR, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, healthcare IT, AI, cloud software, or enterprise technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and consistently exceeding sales quotas.
  • Strong executive-level presentation, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare workflows, interoperability standards (FHIR, APIs), AI technologies, and cloud-based software solutions.
  • Highly self-motivated, organized, strategic, and committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Consistently exceed sales revenue and pipeline targets across enterprise healthcare accounts.
  • Build trusted executive relationships with physicians, practice administrators, and healthcare leadership teams.
  • Position WRS Health as a strategic technology and AI transformation partner within target healthcare organizations.
  • Increase adoption of AI-powered healthcare solutions, automation capabilities, and advanced platform functionality.
  • Improve sales cycle effectiveness through strong discovery, solution alignment, and executive engagement.
  • Generate long-term customer growth opportunities through account expansion and strategic partnerships.
  • Contribute market insights and customer intelligence that influence product innovation and go-to-market strategy.

At WRS Health, the Strategic Sales Executive plays a critical role in helping healthcare organizations embrace AI-driven transformation while accelerating the company’s growth and leadership in specialty healthcare technology.
